comment: I think I just do not learn the way Prof. Zook teaches. It is very lecture heavy and the tests are based a lot on reading from the textbooks. I found the class a bit challenging because I never knew what to study. Just didn't vibe well with her.

Zook is a good professor and the information is interesting, but it does get boring when you're just lectured at. If you attend class, take notes, and do the average amount of reviewing for the tests, you will do well in the class. Overall, if you want a decent professor, not a lot of work, and fair tests, take her and this class.

Joan Zook has my heart. My class was async so I hardly met her but I just know shes the sweetest thing on earth. She makes the class sooo interesting and I honestly left it thinking Id 100% be a psych major if I werent in education. Take her class ESPECIALLY if youre not in psych. Its super super easy and really interesting.

she's a really great professor! genuinely wants to see all of her students succeed, gives a clear explanation when she takes points off, and the workload was fair for a 200-level class. the weekly quizzes are easy: half the questions are straight from the textbook and the other half are usually online. id recommend her!
tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class', 'Clear grading criteria']

comment: I took PSYC216 with Zook online and she was great. Her lectures are interesting and the assignments and quizzes are fairly easy. If you do all of your work, it will be an easy A.

She's so sweet and isn't too demanding. The workload is doable and the content is interesting. I had her asynchronous online and it is the easiest class this semester. I do feel like I am learning, though. Take her!

I would recommend Dr. Zook, this class or any of her others to other students in a heartbeat! This class is 90% discussion based which I was fearful of at first ( I hate speaking in class) but Dr. Zook made it so easy and fun. Everything we learned you can truly apply to your life and future. TAKE THIS CLASS YOU WON'T REGRET IT!

Loved this class! I feel like I learned so much in her lectures and apply a lot of it in my life. Super nice woman, would definitely take another class with her. Grade was based on easy in-class and take home assignments and 3 tests. One of my favorite psych classes I've taken here so far.

Who cares? This lady is amazing. Take her by all means. Shes understanding, enthusiastic, funny, slightly sarcastic (not in a hurtful way), and doesnt require much for the class at all. I will definitely take professor Zook again before leaving Geneseo, as soon as I get the chance

Dr. Zook is one of the most compassionate professors I've had at Geneseo. I was going through a lot when I took her PSYC452 class and she was extremely understanding, flexible, and generous with me (without being a push-over). Her class is definitely rigorous, but her main priority is that her students learn and excel, which I really appreciated.

She's really nice and makes the lectures fairly interesting. You should attend class if you expect to get a good grade, almost all of the testing material is taught through class, and try to take as detailed as the outlines are not enough. Not the most accommodating teacher, but great at what she does. Test material feels unpredictable at times
tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Inspirational', 'Graded by few things']

comment: Professor Zook is fine, but Ive never been more bored out of my mind. If you have the slightest psych background, the material is SO intuitive. 3 tests, a paper, and in class assignments.

Dr. Zook is amazing, helpful, clear, and gives intriguing lectures.  95% of the exam material were things covered in her lectures, class discussions and films watched in class. The exams are a little challenging, but if you study its an easy A. There is one paper, but as long as you follow the guidelines she provides, it is easy.

I literally looked forward to every lecture, and I was never disappointed. She is so enthusiastic about what she teaches, and she is so incredibly knowledgable. Go to every class, the notes are the key to success in this course. The case studies are easy, and she is not a strict grader. Definitely want to take more classes with her in the future.
Interesting class.  The topic seems simple enough but the exams are still challenging.  Dr. Zook is not the worse professor at SUNY Geneseo.

Dr. Zook is so helpful and I would definitely recommend her for 352! There were HW assignments due every class, but most were not that bad. We had two papers, and one was submitted in sections. Her feedback was incredibly helpful and anytime I had a question about something she was more than willing to help.

Read the textbook, it helps on exams. Her short answer questions seem straight forward, but she's very particular on grading these, if you say something wrong or even slightly incorrect, she'll dock points. Case studies are a grade booster. Participation activities will help some. But don't skip class too many times, those stack up if you miss them

The easiest class I've ever taken, and I'm not a psych major. The notes are extremely clear. Go to class for participation activities, skim the book before the tests. Easiest tests ever, require almost no thinking. The case studies are simple, class average on them is often a 100. I highly recommend for an easy A.

Easy A if you pay attention in class and prepare for exams in some way. 3 tests and 2 page case study papers on interesting case studies. She is not the best lecturer but the information is pretty interesting and easy to work with.
Professor is nice but exams are a bit tricky. Class attendance is mandatory! One could do well if they study hard.

You have to go to class. There are in-class pointsand you'll miss a lot. Especially since the tests require lecture material (what the prof says, not just the powerpoints), videos, textbook. Read the textbook the week of the test. The writing assignments are fun and simple! Exams require studying but isn't impossible. Prof is always wiling to help!

Way harder than her adolescent development class. Tests are so hard and the questions are really specific. I had to work really hard to get an A. I also felt like I was taking a bio class because a lot of the material focused on things that had to do with physical changes and weren't psychological in nature. Study a lot and go to class or your grade will suffer.

This class was so interesting! Tests are easy except for the questions that come out of the book because they tend to be really trivial details. You have to go to class to get participation points. She is super nice, too. Definitely recommend.

Prof. Zook is very nice and approachable. Her tests are difficult if you don't study and read the textbook. You must attend class to receive participation points for in-class-assignments. I loved this class and i recommend her for anyone looking for an interesting class.
Nice professor, but very picky grader and tricky exam questions.  Difficult to get an A in her course.  Attend class for participation points and mini-assignments.

Have to go to class for participation points and notes. Exams are directly from notes and textbook. Read the textbook before exams (at least 3 questions from it). Papers are really easy. Three exams. usually four short answer questions. Be sure to study the class notes in depth. Buy textbook and case study book.

Attendance is not mandatory, but she gives out participation points for just showing up.  Her "papers" are only 2 pages long and super easy, but her tests are really specific and almost impossible if you don't go to class and read the textbook.
She is very nice and friendly. She is passionate about the subject and taught me a lot!  Tests are a little hard but the rest of the class is easy!

You absolutely have to go to class. She puts notes up on a powerpoint that are not avaliable online. Her tests are extremely specific and can be tricky, but if you memorize her class notes and read the book chapters before the test you should do okay. She's a nice lady, and obviously extremely passionate about this subject. Good class.

She's a really clear teacher, but you need to go to class to copy down the notes from the powerpoints. Her tests can be tricky because she asks very specific questions, but if you study her class notes you should be fine. Really nice lady.
She's a great professor, and I found her class Very interesting. her notes were clear and her test fairly straight forward as long as you skim the book and look through your notes.

This class is interesting. The only complaint I have is that she asks the smallest details on her tests for questions from the book. But there is only like 4 of those on every test so it's not bad. Oh yeah, she isn't bad looking either

I really enjoyed Dr. Zook's class.  She's a really great professor. She cares a lot about the students and is really easy to understand.  She's very straightforward and is passionate about her subject.Tests are pretty straightforward. Skim the book before tests, go to review sessions and you'll do very well! All around great class, great professor!

She is a very nice person, and is easy to understand.  Her powerpoints are clear and the tests are straightforward.  The class material is mostly common sense, although it is still important to skim the chapters and focus on the bolded items before tests.

Dr. Zook isn't as easy as everyone claims her to be. Granted, she gives out participation points, but her tests are pretty difficult. I have found myself disappointed after having seen people rate her as relatively easy. Don't be so guillible and naive as I was!

one of the best psych teachers at geneseo. talks pretty fast but her notes are incredibly clear. her tests are very very easy as long as you know the notes and skim the book. gives lots of participation so go to class and you can get a pretty easy A
The information is pretty much common sense. If you study and read the book you should definitely get an A! She seems like a nice lady too.
Great professor. She makes the material very interesting. Just know the notes and skim the book for tests. Particaption is a significant part of the grade, and one ten pager, but the class is easy!

My mom had a heart attack and I had to miss a test in class and she didn't believe me. Who lies about something like that?! Other than her being a horrible, extremely-feminist, anti-stay-at-home-mother person, her tests are mult. choice where at least 3 answers are correct and you have to pick which is the best. Take a diff. prof for 216.
Great Professor, this class is really intresting!  The test are fairly easy as long as you take good notes!  She is super nice!

Dr. Zook is an excellent professor.  She jumps between topics a lot, but gives organized notes. Tests aren't too difficult and she is fair on papers.  Make sure you go to class, because she gives participation points.  I would be very comfortable asking her for help, etc.  I'd definitely recommend her
Dr. Zook Is really fun, and super nice.

Class was tedious at times, material is a bit dry.  But a lot of the classes are mediated by discussion which is entertaining.  She's very helpful and knowledgable, a nice lady.  You don't necessarily need to read the book for notes, but you will notice that there are about 10 questions on each exam that come directly from the book.

I really enjoyed this class. I felt like professor zook knew what she was teaching. Her testing style in this class consisted of journal entrys and written work (take home tests) rather than formal in class testing which I appreciated. I would reccomend this class to anyone who is interested in the topic.

I love this class! It's so interesting, and Dr. Zook teaches it very well. You can tell that she really enjoys teaching it, which makes it more fun to learn. Definitely not an easy A, though. Her tests are somewhat difficult.

Ok! Dr. Zook is amazing. Her teaching style will grasp your attention. Her class is not boring...not at all. Just go to class every day, take notes of what she's saying, memorize your entire notes and understand them as well. Read the book material and you'll get your A.

Professor Zook was extremely helpful in this class! She helped inspire motivation in me for a class I was nervous to take, and that to me says a lot! She worked with me on assignments and you could tell she loved what she was doing. It was easy to feed off of her enthusiasm and love for research.

She was very clear and helpful- class was interesting and very discussion oriented!  I would definitely reccommend it to anyone the least bit interested in psych.  But be sure to read the book!!!  There were some concepts on her tests we never got to in class!  Fair grader though, go to class and you'll do well.

i had her for psyc intro and 216. apparently she does a great job in 216 compared to what she did in psyc intro. she is always very nice and clear of what she is talking about. her class is interesting b/c she can always get my attention. plus her tests are fair if you read and go to classes.
Class can be a bit boring at times but it's not too bad. She's nice and will help you if you need it.

This teacher makes class interesting. You must pay attention and take notes, and read the book, but it is not hard to pass this class because she is very clear about everything. She shows relevant video clips as well as interesting statistics. I highly recommend taking Dr. Zook (rhymes with "book")
No Comments
Somewhat tough for a 100 level course, you have to read the book to do well on the exams as there is material not covered in class.  Interesting but challenging.

She's not that bad as some students said about her. In fact, she's generous with the extra credits. so do whatever you can to get all of them. But you do need to take good notes and read everything in the book in order to get a good grade. I did everything and i could get an A in her 100 level.

this was a tough class for 100 level, but i really enjoyed it.  the class was interesting and she always had good examples to remember things by.  you must READ and go to CLASS, and you will do well.  exams are challenging but fair.
the class is pretty interseting but she doesnt teach a lot of the material in class that you need for the tests. must read the book and take notes on what she says in class to do well

I was surprised to see other students' ratings for Zook. I really enjoy her class and enjoy her stories that she includes to help clarify things. This is my last class on Fridays and she's still able to keep my attention the whole time - i'd say that says enough :)

the class is interesting, but not her. sometimes she's so confusing and you have to read everything in the book in order to get a good grade. she tests you more than what she covers in class, omg, the test is so hard. but still, i found this class interesting because i like psychology.
The class is very interesting, she knows what she's talking about, and tests are challenging but fair.

Great teacher, keeps class interesting and involved with case study discussions and group activities (both easy), sometimes shows videos. Her tests are challenging, but if you pay attention in class and read, you will succeed.
The course is pointless
No Comments
tests are fair but difficult if you don't go to class or read the book.  however, she's willing to give extra points for ambiguous test questions. overall, nice prof, knows her stuff

Wendy Pogozelski is a kind and caring prof who's also a super passionate and insightful. I believe she made Biochem 1 & 2 (which contain a ton of difficult material) much more memorable, accessible and easy to retain. She provides lots of real life context and examples in her slides and lectures which I think really help. Highly Recommend.

Very assignment-heavy; interactive lectures helped understand the material. She can't do math in front of other people, which hinders your ability to ask critical questions about the lecture when you think of it. I found more support in the SI sessions than I did from any conversation or lecture with her.

Super nice, but can get confused during the lecture & tends to read off the slides. She loves when students come to her office hours, while not always being the most helpful, I found it important to communicate any issues I had with the class. Attendance isn't manditory but she does give extra credit. GO TO SI SESSIONS!

Professor Pogo is an extremely caring woman; she would do anything for her students. Unfortunately, her lectures are all over the place. Over 200 slides on each chapter, she skips most of the examples and doesn't give you time to do them. She is accessible out of class, but she cannot do work in front of people and has trouble explaining things.
I like her, she's very nice, but if you didn't take chemistry in high school this class is really hard. The tests aren't too bad though!

Professor Pogo is a lovely woman and very smart but is not cut out for teaching, she's quiet, runs through slides, and does not give many examples. She does not give much information and depends on LAs to explain everything during lab. Try to stay away.

Dr. Pogo is super nice but can be disorganized and not clear. Many students in my class were often confused with instruction and grading. She's super intelligent and definitely fine to take lab with. Just make sure you always ask for clarification.

Dr. Pogo was very kind. Her lectures moved fast, and I didn't feel prepared for the tests from them. However, I found reading out of the book and doing practice worked. I didn't think her lectures did much for me but there were schedule circumstances. She offered extra credit and help where she could but sometimes was confused. Sweet lady though!

She's a nice person if you just want to talk and is accommodating if you need to make up a test. However, she talked very very fast in her lectures and would give students literally 30 seconds to complete 5 minute problems. She spent way too much time on the lore of old chemists that were never asked about on the tests.

She talks fast and doesn't go over things even if people have a question. In lectures spends very little time on the things that actually matter. She talks a lot on the old chemist guys when that's not what is on the test. Went in for office hours and she was little to no help. Would not recommend taking her class.

Dr. Pogo is a really sweet professor and cares a lot about her students, but I had a hard time following the lectures and ended up having to go to a lot of SI sessions to understand the material. A lot of other people did poorly because she goes through a lot of material super quickly and it's hard to retain.

I have never had a teacher that literally just reads directly off the slides and gives no outside information off the slides and then blows through the practice problems without explaining everything... I would not recommend taking her as a professor to anyone.

She teaches unbelievably fast, spends approximately 30 seconds on each slide, and doesn't give you any time to take notes. I have started looking at the notes ahead of time, doing about 30-40 slides and taking notes on them myself, while teaching myself the material, which has taken 2+ hours I could be using for other classes. Very awful experience

Dr. Pogozelski is clearly an extremely intelligent professor and is without a doubt qualified to teach chemistry. However, she has a tendency to make errors in her math and other lecture material that can make it hard to understand new concepts. Additionally, she teaches rather fast so note taking can be a challenge.

I loved her class! As long as you know the slides, you'll do well on the exam. Granted, there are a lot of slides, but going over them within 24hrs like she suggests is actually really helpful. She is a very caring person and tries to make herself accessible to students' schedules.

Literally one of the worst professors I have ever had. Often uses the excuse "I'm busy" for not posting homework on time/helping students and unreliable/unorganized. Go to the SI, it's the only place you will learn and only reason i had an A-. Very passive aggressive about asking for help, yet doesn't understand why students don't go to office hour

She is a well-respected Prof. and a great individual. But, since the pandemic started I have felt like her teaching is underwhelming. She takes on many obligations, therefore, has a hard time keeping up with student needs. It has become difficult contacting her or ask questions. Her class will not be easy. If you ever need help, go elsewhere.

comment: I do not get the hype. I heard so many good things but this class was not it. She was often rude, would talk badly about the online students to the in person class, and complained about how much work she had while giving us extra homework. Super passive aggressive. Difficult exams but if you know the slides you'll be fine. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT.

She is a great teacher-the material is very clear, and I have no problem understanding what is expected of me. That being said, she is not always the kindest. Learning during COVID is stressful, and she is not very accommodating to the needs of her students. Things often fall through the cracks.
tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Amazing lectures', 'Lecture heavy']

comment: This class fills up fast, so take it if you can get in. There's of review throughout the year so you remember all of the information by the time the final comes around. She is very accessible outside of class and a fair professor when it comes to assignments and grading.

She is by far the best professor to take this class with at Geneseo. She keeps lecture interesting and relevant, and as long as you understand the slides you will be set for the tests (your lowest test grade is dropped). She is always available outside of class and has way more office hours than other profs.

Dr. Wendy Pogozelski is singly the most caring professor I have encountered at SUNY Geneseo. While I gave her a (4/5) for difficulty, that is mostly because of the intense workload I required to memorize and understand her material. High focus on slides. Office hours are rushed, but very helpful. Ask questions because she likes engaged students.
just work hard

Has a lot of examples that are really in depth but doesn't make it clear what we have to know and don't have to know. Tests are made up with questions that are very detailed and irrelevant to the core material. Not that helpful during office hours. Unfortunately she is the only biochemistry professor right now so there are no other options.

She is so helpful and makes the class very interesting. Everything is given a practical application so you can understand why it is important to learn it. She gives a lot of help on homework and is a very fair grader. Overall, this is one of the best classes I've ever taken at Geneseo and I cab't wait to take Biochem II with her next semester

Pogo is definitely one of the better teacher's I have had as a biochem major. She's very smart and her lectures are interesting filled with lots of applications. Sometimes she can be a bit neurotic but shes really passionate and it shows. I would recommend her to anyone interested in biochem! Tests and hw arent bad you just have to study a lot!!

Dr. Pogo's class was very interesting. She takes everything we learn in biochem and gives us some sort of application or story behind it that makes it even more interesting. Tests were fair and homework helped apply what you learned in class. You don't need to read the text because her notes are pretty good. Id definitely recommend taking her class

She is very helpful at office hours and is a very nice person.  However, her notes are often very unclear and contradicting and she doesn't always do the best job explaining things.  Her exams are mostly fair.  Great 300 level class but Dr. Pogozelski needs to be a lot more concise and clear.

I think she is a great professor for this class. She tries to limit the amount of memorization and instead teach the application of the science and how concepts link together. She's not the most social of professors and has to make an effort, but she is excellent one on one and her office hour time is gold.

Pogo is one of the best Chem professors I've ever had. She may seem a bit intimidating at first but GO TO HER REVIEW SESSIONS!! Shes very helpful and friendly. She teaches a lot of material based on how it is actually used and makes a lot of stuff interesting that way. If you show her you care about the class, she will notice. TAKE HER! :)

Dr. Pogo is a great professor.  She knows her subject very well and shows interest in it.  Tells some great stories about her experiences.  She's kind of intimidating, especially in office hours, but I'm not sure why, she's really nice.  Pay attention, go to review, do homework.

If you make calc errors easily, this is not the class for you. She's a nice person and it's obvious she cares, but she offers none to little partial credit which is a killer on tests. If you don't love chemistry, I would take it w/ a different professor. Incredibly hard class. Incredibly strict professor.

Dr. Pogo's classes always come with a discalimer. It seems as though she cares a little to much about what freshman in her class write about her on this website. She is an extremely intelligent woman who knows her subject well. Apart from being too self-conscience, Dr. Pogo is a good teacher and her class is doable if you are willing to do the work

she can be nice and she can get angry and be mean.  she gives no partial credit and it's really easy to fail her tests - they are hard and she is kind of an unfair grader.  she likes office hours and she's good at teaching one-on-one.  she messes up notes a lot though, and sometimes confuses herself and that can be frustrating.  she's really smart.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THIS PROFESSOR. She does not give out ANY partial credit and doesn't seem to think you're working your butt off as it is. She seems to think everyone is a chem major. Save yourself and take this class with anyone but her.
No Comments

Wendy is one of the most amazing professors ive ever had the pleasure of having. go to class and just do the work, it really isnt difficult if you stick to her slides. Office hours are awesome too. Amazing.

Chem II was an excellent class to take.  Excellent comminicator and always more than willing to go the extra mile.  Her tests, though difficult at times, are directly based off of the lectures.  She Shows enthusiasm and brings a lot of examples and demonstrations. Being polite and respectful are as critical as attending class. A definite choice.
Stick to her notes and you will do good. She is one of the BEST professors in SUNY Geneseo. If you want her to like you be very "respectful"...

Class structure and notes are extremely helpful and review sessions really reinforced everything very nicely.  She really bends over backwards for all her students!  Do take the extra mile to be polite with her though.

One of the best teachers in Geneseo. I took both chem 2 and biochem 1 with her and so far I got nothing but praises for her. One thing: BE VERY RESPECTFUL, no joke...  100% of the exam comes from her notes/lecture.
Wendy is an amazing professor!! Take any class you can with her! She is very devoted to helping her students and being fair.
always be ontime, go to her review classes, easy multiple choice questions on tests but tough grader on long answer work, keep up with the homework and you'll be fine

She gives NO partial credit, so even if you demonstrate understanding of the concept but make a stupid mistake, you fail. She has an air of superiority and smiles derisively at students who ask questions. She assigns work before teaching how to do it. The class is too hard for a 100 level. She's not mean, she's just not fair.
No Comments

Her notes are not powerpoints so you have to go to class but they are straightforward and she tells you exactly what is going to be on the tests. You have to keep up with material because there are quizzes and homeworks that alternate every week. I would definately recommend her.
i love her.  straightforward, fair, and helpful, but can be a little shy and flustered at times.

Pogozelski makes biochem such an interesting subject! Class was swell, the lectures were interesting, and she's very, VERY helpful if you need the extra help. She also adds humour to the class! (ah, those wonderful little stories about her Hopkins experience!)

NICE lady, very perky and energetic, nice notes to go along with the pre-lab lectures. She expects you to pay attention and know what you're doing BEFORE you walk into lab, which can be a problem for some since Orgo lab isn't necessarily easy. She does her part well though and I'd recommend her as a proctor. Only gave 1 quiz this semester.
Tough class, She expects A LOT, but she is kind, fair, and will help you if you need it. Do not try going to the bathroom during a test ;)
She is an awesome professor.  Makes the subject easy and likeable.
best prof geneseo has!  did a great job simplifying a difficult subject. she was great in general chem but biochem is obviously her thing.

Wendy is the most awesome professor ever!  She made classes interesting and her tests are very straight forward.  She really cares about her students.  (Oh, and her vintage 80s outfits are the best thing ever!)
Wendy is great. Class is setup so that if you work hard you will definately succeed. She is very fair and easy to learn from. I will definately take biochem with her.
always there for help, go to the tutor for homeworks, REALLY willing to get to know you by name and work with your grade if you're struggling

Overall, she is a good professor.  As with any science major course, it takes a lot of time to study and do the homeworks.  There is HW/Quiz, alternating every week.  She is very responsive via E-mail, too.

She is a very nice woman and incredibly fair.  She gave me points on a quiz when the answer was wrong but there was outside circumstances.  Her tests I feel are a bit harder than the quizzes and homeworks you do, so you do have to spend time studying.
Tests fair, hws every other week, quizzes every week hw isn't due. Very nice and approachable.
No Comments

She does, indeed, have self-esteem issues, but some of these may be warranted.  She's extremely bright in her field, but she doesn't have a handle on how to impart her knowledge to her students.  It takes more than being nice to be a college professor.

Great teacher extremely nice, though not easy to get in contact with outside of office hours/class because she's continuously busy.  Biochem is still a hard class, but her lectures are definately not boring.
Easy to understand and a nice person, but she has some self esteem issues that she really shouldn't have because she really is a good teacher
Goated. That's all
Extremely dense exams

Be prepared to put in some physical effort, especially during warmups. It was extremely intimidating for me as someone with no dance experience to keep up with the pace of everyone else, but we are all graded by our ability, not perfection. Oh, and the tests can be annoying to study for so make sure you take enough notes during the lecture portions

Professor French made sure that this beginners class was made for BEGINNERS and expected as much. She ensured there was no judgement and was very fair when it came to injuries. Exams are a little difficult if you don't pay attention in lecture classes, but the questions at the ends of slides are literally the same. Have those, and you'll ace it.

Professor French is high energy, caring and kind. Class has a lecture day and a movement day, two tests that are mainly based on lectures but had some movement questions. Attend a performance and write about it, choreograph a two minute dance with a group and write about it. Attendance is mandatory (otherwise there are makeup assignments)

Class is split into movement and lecture classes. Lectures are a disaster. Movement classes are somewhat fun, but do not tell her you're a dancer unless you want to be called out to dance in front of class the whole semester. She is very nice and enthusiastic but can be passive aggressive, too, if she becomes slightly bothered with the class.

Dance 100 was taken with the expectation the course would be easy. The class is divided into two days: lecture and movement. You cannot miss a class for the makeups are quite lengthy and difficult, along with movement days demanding lots of effort and physicality for full credit. Professor French, although nice struggles with disorganization

I took this class for my gen ed art, she is an upbeat professor and does not expect a lot. In-class participation is easy and she doesn't mind if you mess up as long as you try. A lot of material is covered, so studying is important for the tests, but there are only 2. Final is a group choreographic project: 2 minute dance and reflective paper.

She calls people out when she thinks they can't see the board or when they mess up dancing. She reads off the slides and just watches videos. There is a lot of content to her lectures which is too much to keep ahold of. The movement days are somewhat fun only if you know dance, but don't take her class if you don't know anything.

She calls out people for their flaws or points at people in the room when she calls them out for not being able to see the board. She is really nice at times but when she gets frustrated she comes off as mean. She rushes through slides for the bigger units that she should cut down. The movement days are fun though.

This professor was really passionate about dance and made the class that many dread to be a ton of fun. Just try and you will get credit for participation and if you miss a class the makeup assignments are fair and easy. Exams are not too challenging but you definitely need to study for them! Go through the slides and know the names of people.

The only complaint about this prof is that canvas is a hot mess. There is this authorization thing and it's very difficult to navigate. But a pretty fun class and lots of laughs/ and friends were made in this class. If you want an easy A I would totally recommend this class. Just make sure that you keep up with the assignments and you will do fine.

Professor French is very sweet but a horrible teacher. Her lectures are a mess, and so is her canvas. Participation alone won't get you a good grade because she makes her tests pretty difficult. You have to attend performances outside of class and write about them. If you want a good gen ed, this isn't the class. She treats it like a 300 level.
There are two written exams. Questions are lecture heavy and I read articles for test help. The studio is a great time. She makes the class very fun and motivating!!

Professor French is very caring and wants you to succeed. Your attendance is graded, there are 3 non-cumulative exams, and extra credit is offered. You will have to study since there is a lot of material, but studying will guarantee a good grade.
I had no idea how to dance at all, but she made sure that even if you were like me and didn't know what you were doing, you still could participate and enjoy it!! I recommend this prof!

French was a great professor and really enthusiastic about her work. That being said be sure to really study her notes for the tests because theyre really detailed, almost unnecessarily difficult for a dance 100 level course (each test average was a c for the class). She also grades attendance which is a huge chunk of your grade so dont skip.

Professor French is really amazing teacher. She is very attentive to all of her students and is really passionate about dance which makes the class really entertaining to be in and keeps you engaged all of the time. She has lecture classes and studio classes that alternate depending on the style you're learning that week. Highly recommend her class

A great professor. Easy to do well in the class if you pay attention and do the work. Understands that as college students we don't always want to stay in class the whole 2 and a half hours so he lets us out early occasionally. If he taught any other classes I would definitely take him again.
interactive, direct and his slides are easy to follow, easy tests, definitely recommend him.

A Monday night, 2.5 hour lecture sounds terrible, but it is actually not too bad. You need to go to class because of the quiz but powerpoints are easy to follow. Tests are so easy if you pay attention. The essays are a little hard but he gives you enough time to get a good grade.

This was Bauer's first year at Geneseo. Although a 2 and a half hour class on a Monday night sounds daunting, Bauer is good enough to make it worth it. Always clear and concise. The class is very easy if you put in the effort to do well. If you need to take this class as a poli sci major (like me) or just for a gen ed, I definitely recommend it.

By far my favorite professor I've had at SUNY Geneseo. I had a difficult time this semester with keeping up with work and he was incredibly understanding and helpful. He always made time to meet with me and clear up any confusion I had. His lectures are really interesting and he does a great job explaining everything and making it interesting!
Dr. Lalena is amazing and does a great job during lectures. However, he is a very harsh grader on writing assignments.

Really good guy, clearly passionate about what he teaches and is super understanding + he acts like a real person. A G.O.A.T for real. Super chill guy, and maybe its because this class is required for my major but was super understanding given the circumstances I was facing this semester. Textbook is "mandatory" for this class, but I did the entire class without reading a thing in it and did fine.

He was an amazing professor with so much knowledge! He relates everything to things that we can understand as students in the 21st century. It's often hard learning history from times like the 12th century but Professor Lalena makes it so much fun, and very interesting.

jazz songs are big part

Extremely smart, so smart that she kind of has trouble organizing her thoughts.  She's extremely helpful outside of class and I think if you go to her that she'll help you out better there if you don't understand something.

She was the worst professor I've ever had. I couldn't understand a word she was saying and the content seemed ridiculously hard and confusing. Didn't give anywhere near enough time on tests.
please stay away from professor park. avoid her if you value your education and grades.

difficult and hard to understand but oh so hot!!

she was mean and she never read my emails. she graded very harshly even through I was one of the only to get all my work in on time.

Golec is helpful when you ask for help and she does want people in her class to succeed. You need to show up for most of the class days to do well in the class. Unreasonably difficult for an introduction level class, no accommodations for COVID whatsoever, and if these are the accommodations, than I don't want to see what the normal class is like. She may be passionate about what she teaches, and she may touch others with her teaching in a way I don't get, but if you think this will be fun... think again.

Here is your classic "My class is the most important thing in the world, so you should focus solely on it, and forget everything else." kind of professor. Both MUSC 110 and 120 are unreasonably difficult for intro level classes, that both require 8 page research papers. She has made no accommodations for COVID and it shows, to be Frank STAY AWAY!!!

Took this class to fulfill one of my last gen eds as it was one of the few available online fine arts credits. Golec was a hard grader, taking off so many points on homework grades for minor mistakes. She also required a final exam and an 8 page final paper for an intro music gen ed class, taught asynchronously online in a pandemic.

She grades each assignment out of 250 points and the midterm and final out of 2,000. Not to mention she gave hw during finals week on top of an 8-page essay AND a final. 2 assignments brought my grade from a 96 to a 90...

This class was awful. I took it as a gen-Ed & it was so much work. She takes attendance very seriously, assigns lots of hw and grades it thoroughly. She gives tests pretty often too. comment: She takes attendance every day so go to class. She explains things very well and gives you time in class to work on what you learned. She grades homework harshly so check your work before you submit it. If you know what you're doing and go to class she will like you. It shows that she wants her students to succeed in her class. Put in effort though

This is not the gen ed class you want to take. It is a trap class and is very hard even if you do attend class. MUSC 100 with this professor does is not the easy gen ed you want it to be. Doesn't seem like a gen ed at all. You definitely have to put in the time and effort in studying for the exams or you won't do well. She's a tough grader but gives out study guides which are helpful.

comment: Very good professor her exams are not that easy but shes gives you a review sheet and if you do it youll be perfect.

If you have a music background and love music, definitely take this class. However, if you're not experienced with reading music definitely do not, because it is almost entirely musical notation. Dr. Golec is a great teacher! She is very good at explaining things, and I really liked her as a person. She is very engaged and always answers questions!

She takes attendance every class and you have to bring both of your textbooks to the class every day because of in-class activities with the books. Class materials are easy as long as you pay attention and do practices.
Took basic musicianship (MUSC 110) with Golec. Easy A. Numerous homework assignments but they're easy and boost your grade. Golec is witty and loves what she does.

She is a genius in music. She can answer any question. There is a LOT of reading involved. Make sure to come to all classes and participate (she will ask for volunteers to read poems or reviews). Golec is a fair grader and will explain her grading system. Will not put up with bad behavior.

Dr. Golec is one of the most unpleasant professors I've had the displeasure of dealing with in my entire college career. She is unhelpful, unreasonably tough, and expects way too much. AVOID LIKE THE PLAGUE

Golec is a genius in music. She knows so much, but with that being said, she expects a lot out of her students. It is an intro level class for non music majors, but it seems like the opposite. I learned a lot in this class, if you pay attention and read the textbook, it is not too bad.
Golec is great! She isn't easy but she is very fair and willing to  help. Its manageable if you put in the work.

Professor Golec's class is strictly memorization. Her tests are fairly easy. Her Basic Musicianship class is the easiest I've taken at Geneseo. She's also really pretty and dresses like a model. Plus!

She works really fast, and if you have played a instrument or understand music it is an easy A. She is very specific on how she grades, but she always reviews. If you don't understand something she will review it multiple times with you. The homework is a must, and the tests are relatively easy if you do well on the homework and quizzes.

Golec doesn't normally teach 110, but the usual professor was ill. I have no complaints about Golec. She was clear and always willing to help and slow down if the class wasn't understanding. There's a TON of assignments, but they're easy if you really take the time to do them. If you have any musical knowledge at all, this class is easy. Take it.

Music history is a fun class with her. That being said, she expects a LOT from her students. Don't take her if you want to cruise through and expect an A. She is a fair grader there's just a ton of info! Her handouts are really helpful to study from

Soo nice! Don't really need the text book for her intro to music history. She gives out outlines everyday which are extremely helpful! Participate in her class or she will give quizzes. Overall she is insanely smart and an amazing professor to have

I thought this class would be fairly easy but was wrong. It required a lot of outside studying, and Professor Golec teaches the class as though you have background knowledge of the material. In order to do well you must read the book thoroughly and be prepared for her pop quizzes. You do end up learning a lot, but this class is rather stressful.

She teaches this class just as hard as a 300 level which seems unfair. She does not answer emails. I'm doing alright in the class but if I did not have a pretty extensive music background I would be completely lost, and probably failing.  Don't take this for a fine arts credit if you cannot already read music and understand its basic forms.

For a class designed for non-music majors, she relies too much on background musical knowledge. She is pretty intimidating as well. Most people usually give up once they see how hard the tests are, but you really need to put work into this class in order to do well. Much harder than a gen ed should be. It's harder only if you don't put n the work.

Great teacher and kind person. She truly wants to help students and have them do well, but you have to be willing to put in work as well. As long as you do the reading and complete the assignments the class isn't hard. Tests are straightforward. She's not boring or mean towards students at all
LOVE HER.
The funniest professor I've had so far...

Professor Harrigan is the BEST professor in Geneseo no doubt. She cares about students and about what she teaches. The class is easy but feels meaningful with crafts to help you think deeper about the topics.

THIS IS MY FAV PROFESSOR OF ALL TIME EVER!!!! Omg. Harrigan is super sweet, super funny, super animated and full of life. I NEVER had a boring lecture. grade is entirely on class participation and then 2 projects. No exam, no book. She made everything super easy to understand and is an amazing storyteller. If you have the option, TAKE HER CLASS!!!
Lovely professor. Very unconventional class, but still felt like I learned a lot. Hardly any assignments outside of class. An easy A if you are willing to participate and listen to feedback.

Harrigan has the sweetest most bubbly personality. Her passion for the content is reflected in every lecture. She truly cares about her students and wants everyone to thrive. Focus on group projects (pretty painless), class discussion, and participation. Easy to meet outside of class. So sweet and kind, very high energy and loves her family & work!

Meredith's kindness is endless. The class itself was so interesting and therapeutic. The range of topics we discussed were productive and meaningful. I STRONGLY recommend this class to everyone because of how important it is. Meredith makes you feel heard, understood, and valued. I hope my future educational endeavors include her as an instructor!

Real-life angel. I love Meredith, she truly cares about her students. Took comn209 with her, a super easy class, 1 test only, and a semester-long group project. 100% recommend taking a course, any course with her!

I took her for Interpersonal Communication. She is amazing 10/10! I recommend that everyone takes her courses. She is very chill and caring about her students. The class is made up of everyday lectures about learning concepts and vocabulary. Harrigan does an extraordinary job of doing that and helps you understand. You will love class with her!

Prof. Harrigan is fantastic. She is super sweet and cares about her students and the material. The whole class is focused around 4 group projects, 4 project reflections, and 4 individual papers, along with a final exam. She is very enthusiastic and makes the material interesting. The final project decides the format of the final! Take her classes!

Meredith is very lecture heavy but she makes everything really easy to understand. If you have any issues, just talk to her, she will always find a way to make things work. All of the classwork is pretty straightforward. Her classes are very by the book but if you try to have fun with it, it's not bad at all!

Dr. Harrigan is by far the most genuine, passionate, and caring professor at Geneseo. Her enthusiasm and passion can't be beat and it's quite honestly inspiring. If I could be mmh when I grow up, I would be in pretty good shape. Her lectures are engaging and excellently supplement the textbook reading (which I recommend for an A). 100% recommend!!!

Professor Harrigan is a fantastic professor. She is probably the most fair professor I have met. The amount of work you put in is probably the grade you will get. Her lectures are kind of useless, but attendance isn't counted (but she does notice who comes and doesn't). She isn't as bad with APA as some will say, but I would learn it. Also read!

Although it is true Dr. Harrigan makes you work for an A in her class and I found her tests to be harder than a typical 100-level course, if you put in the effort, an A is 100% doable. She's extremely helpful & responsive if you ask, and I feel like I learned a lot from her. Will definitely take classes with her again

The material itself is not hard to understand but the way she tests is difficult (the way she words the questions, answer choices, etc). She is a stickler for APA so you have to watch out for little mistakes.

comment: Harrigan is a ray of sunshine. I didnt really like the class material but she made it fun. Dr. Harrigan is a very nice woman. Very mother-like, incredibly friendly, and clearly cares about her students. The class only has 7 grades: 3 tests and 4 papers. comment: If I could be half the professor mmh is, then I'd be a lucky person indeed. Her enthusiasm towards her subject and her overwhelming positivity are infectious. The lectures hardly feel like 2.5 hours and she does a phenomenal job weaving theory and practical application into a format that is understandable. Perfect APA, study, & you'll do great.

She does her best to make the subject clear but the class remains miserable. She grades insanely harshly on the papers. If you are not intimately familiar with APA, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. A really good- but not 100% perfect- paper with only 2 mistakes (typo or form) will net you an 80. (33/45). 5 mistakes takes off another 3 points (66%)

Harrigan is a kind professor and very well put together. She is very organized and likes to have a schedule but this class is not as structured bc of the collaboration with foreign university. She works with her discomfort  becoming VERY flexible- changing due dates and work based on what benefits the class. I Love her personality for this class

mmh is an amazing professor!  She is very sweet and kind and she truly wants her students to do well in the class.  There are four 4 page papers to do throughout the semester and a total of 3 easy 50 multiple choice tests (2 unit tests and 1 cumulative final). I highly recommend taking any class you can with her!

One of the greatest professors at Geneseo. Never in a bad mood, super enthusiastic about the course material, very knowledgeable and helpful all around. Like someone said before, expects perfection on APA format, which is the only thing bad I can say about her

Not many professors could keep me interested for a 2.5 hour class, but Harrigan did. Her lectures are interesting and enthusiastic and her happy, sweet, bubbly personality is contagious. Tests can be hard, definitely need to study. A few written papers - fair grader. Wonderful professor, good class - definitely recommend!

Loveliest lady at Geneseo. There are no negatives to her personality: she is direct, caring, very knowledgeable about the subject and is inspired in her field.  If you take a few classes with her at once, expect back to back tests, (not a criticism.) Even if you don't like the material that much her sweetness will get you through it. :)
If you really wanna understand and embrace the core of it, its worth it. I have grown to be a better person by taking this class!
If you really wanna understand and embrace the core of it, its worth it. I have grown to be a better person by taking this class!

Absolutely loved coming to class. So fun and Mmh is enthusiastic, bubbly, and energetic. Course material is interesting and fun. Tough grader-- watch out for APA 6th edition formatting (perfect it). Harrigan is a very smart, nice person.  Great lecturer, although I found her tests a little difficult. Gives good feedback on papers, but is kind of obsessed with apa.  Bottom line:  she's very nice, competent, and committed.  Take her if you can.

I've taken Comn 103, 248, and 317 with Harrigan and she is the most engaging, interesting and helpful professor that I've had at Geneseo. Her knowledge and interest of the subject matter make you interested, too. She just wants you to do well, and as long as you attend most classes you will.

By far the best professor I have had so far at Geneseo. Never before have I had a prof. who cared more about the success of her students and their ability to understand the material. Both her 103 and 345 classes were extremely interesting and I learned so much from each one. If you do the work and take the time do understand it, you will do well.

I want to be Meredith Harrigan when I grow up. I can not say a single bad thing about her. Class is optional and relaxed, tests are easy and multiple choice if its a 200 level, 300 includes essays but not bad, fairly predictable topics. She is just amazing.

Meredith Harrigan is an amazing professor. I am taking a class with her right now and I absolutely love it! She is an extremely warm, friendly and engaging professor. I actually pay attention! She is always helpful and willing to answer any questions. She will never belittle you or make you feel stupid. I plan on taking many more classes with her!

Dr. Harrigan is my FAVORITE professor. She's so cheerful, and going to class always brightens my day. She is a wonderful lecturer, and she definitely knows how to make things interesting. I've never skipped her class, and I was actually disappointed when she had to cancel class once. Fair grader, nice person, awesome professor.

mmh is one of the most engaging lecturers on campus. She's incredibly energetic and keeps everyone in the class on their toes. She is awesome.  Very organized and helpful.  I've taken 4 classes (103, 211, 248, 345) with her and I've learned so much.  She really wants you to learn and she makes it easy for you. MMH is intelligent, organized, and passionate about class material and students. She makes a department with so many incompetent professors much more enjoyable!! Take her class!!!!!!!!!

Tracie is a good professor. She is nice but she is really looking for participation from the class. A lot of extra credit is offered and I got out of my final by going to see a free play. This was her first semester teaching, and it has probably been my least favorite class. This was a fun class and made me interested in the theater in which I knew nothing about beforehand. Put in a moderate amount of effort and you will get a high grade. UHHHH she makes you literally tell the entire class your trauma like if I wanted my therapist Id call her. I feel like Im getting hazed and I hate her, this is absolutely awful. Dr. Cylke is an amazing teacher. Prof. Cylke is a great professor. While the topics can be very heavy and sad, he makes them understandable and why we should care. Most of the grade is based on reading&taking notes on 6 books. comment: Cylke makes a point of caring for his students. You can always ask for an extension and he even cancelled our final due to stress levels. He is a good teacher and the class is really interesting. I would say one of the best classes I have taken. He makes it hard to fail and there are book notes every two weeks. If you budget your time you will pass

You read 6 books in this class. I honestly didn't feel the need to go to class when the midterm was based on a brand new article. He literally had people start writing their names on a paper to give them .25 points added to their grade for showing up... He's a nice guy but the class was rather uninteresting to me. He doesn't allow laptops or phones
Just wanted to come on here and make this comparison--EVERY single one of his lectures feel like a ted talk!! A good one!! Great class.

Literally love Professor Cylke! He is one of best and most understanding professors out there. Late assignments have no penalty. If youre happy with your midterm paper, you can opt out of your final!

He is a very nice professor and very understanding. Allowed late assignments. However, the work load is extremely heavy. 6 books, page by page notes required. Best professor I have ever had. He is extremely caring and always tries to make things easier for you if you are going through stress. The class work load was not a lot and the topics were genuinely interesting. If you need to take a sociology class, take it with Professor Cylke!!
Absolute angel. Cares about his students and does not give too much work at all

His lectures are so insightful and has you question things that you would never have questioned before about tour society and the things happening around us that we do not know that is happening. Makes you read 6 books and do page by page notes for each. I skipped an entire month and got a B but you NEED to do the book notes. Just use upperclassmen book notes, you'll be fine. EASY GRADE

Super chill guy, really passionate about his subject, but his lectures can sometimes drag on because of the lack of participation and note taking. comment: Classes get very dry and boring on multiple occasions. Also, prepare to read six books that can be interesting at first, but make you lose interest as you get deeper in. Good professor but get ready to read 6 long books and take page by page notes. Takes the point out of reading at least to me. 2 easy papers that he gives you on the first day of class. Easy A class

Insightful and thought-provoking class. You have to read about six books and take notes on them, but they really helped you understand sociological issues in America. 2 easy take home essays for the midterm and final.
He gives you enough time to get your assignment done.

He's a great professor and the class very informative. comment: Dr. Cylke is an excellent professor. I really did learn tons, and the coursework was manageable. Prof  cylke was one of the best professors I ever had.
Easy class and very nice professor. One of the best professors I've ever had.

Professor Cylke is clearly passionate about the material, he'll show you graphs and charts about social and economic problems until you've seen them all, but the projects are straightforward and the tests are take-home with opportunity to revise for higher grades. 2 Projects and a midterm and final for this semester, really easy course load.

Professor Cylke is one of the nicest people I've ever met. This class, while sometimes dry, is one of the best classes I've ever taken. We did 2 projects throughout the semester and the midterm and final were take home exams. Definitely recommend this class to anyone remotely interested in sociology.

Professor Cylke is a really great professor. You can tell that he is extremely passionate about sociology. He gives a midterm and a final, both essay exams and two semester-long projects. Could not be happier with Cylke. He's a genuinely interesting person and cares a lot about the material he teaches.  I wasn't happy with my first test grade and he let me rewrite one of the essays & gave me that improved grade for the entire test. Prof Cylke is very smart. I like that he's so involved in the Geneseo community.

Dr. Cylke seems to change to a tough professor that is much different from before. his tests were ez because were take-home. but now students need  to read a lot stuff and prepare all the long essay topic(7 for mid term) for a real test. it may need more then 6 hours extra class reading per week.
Summer course, amazing professor and person :)

Cylke is amazing! He is very entertaining and gets his point across using movies and clips. Very eccentric and a little goofy! You don't really need to attend class to do well...i skipped almost every other class and still got an A. You just need to check the syllabus so you don't miss some assignments and tests. Exams are very easy!

Prof. Cylke is awesome. He bases his classes on what topics students want to be informed about. Class can get boring. Its only  mandatory to get notes. Do the readings and go visit him in office hours and you'll do fine!

Really good guy and not a hard grader.  Very understanding on the work you turn in.  Class mostly just him talking with his strong liberal views.  Doesn't present the other side, sometimes very frustrating.

Cylke's a pretty cool guy. Class topics are interesting but broad, readings are essential. Cylke was a great teacher! He talks most of the class period, but he REALLY knows his stuff. If you are having trouble, go to his office hours. He will give you everything you need to know. By everything... I mean point out the answers. Do the readings. Go to class. You will do great!

Great Professor! He changed the way I view worldly issues. While his opinions are strong, I found it useful to hear a different perspective than what the media is feeding the country. Professor Cylke is a very nice guy. His class can be pretty boring, he talks most of the time, some topics are more interesting than others. Very disorganized. Poor communicator.

Really like professor cylke. He is a very nice guy. The material in this class was sometimes a little boring but he gives three options for grading and the exams are just papers, the final was a take home. I went to his office hours before exams and her was very helpful.
Interesting readings, and occasionally an interesting class. Professor is very nice and helpful, but at the end of the semester I don't feel like I've learned much.

Very nice man.  Helpful if you go to office hours.  He is very opinionated about touchy issues.  Go to class and read all of the material!

Great class, great professor! Would recommend to everyone. The class is easy and you will learn a lot. Thumbs up!

He's the best, he really teaches you a new way of looking at everything around you. You need to take what he says with a grain of salt, he's got strong opinions but welcomes class discussion/debate. Excellent! If you want to get anything out of his class, then DO THE READING! Otherwise, I don't understand why you'd come to class. Very reasonable, if you show him some effort and that you're working with him on a class, he'll work with you. Very knowledgeable and always willing to hear others' POV and hash things out.

comment: Professor Trible is a very caring person that will help you outside of class or if you just send her an email. Graded homework takes forever to get back, which was frustrating because future assignments went off of previous assignments we never got the feedback on. There are many presentations and a lot of group work. I didn't really use the book.

Best professor I've ever had. She will help you out with anything you ask about. She's super friendly! Sometimes she messes up assignment due dates/extends them/etc. But that's okay. There is group work, and you do presentations- But they're easy, and she makes it fun for you. Had 1 midterm, got a 100 on it- Just make sure you take down notes!

Professor Trible is super nice but she's also new, which means sometimes she's disorganized and got way too assignment-happy to the point where she couldn't keep up with it. If you hand in everything ON TIME (she will halve your grade if you don't) and show that you put effort in, you'll get a good grade.

No exams, all busy work. They're pretty easy, but it's really tedious to do the assignments. Really easy class overall, and probably the easiest BCOM professor. I LOVEEEE Roth. I've had her for two classes over 3 years. Her lectures are always so interesting and engaging, making 50 minutes feel like 2. She is very responsive to emails and gives great feedback on any/most assignments. She's honestly one of the best professors I've had at Geneseo. The class itself was very fascinating. A great professor, really good at explaining things deeper. Easy class, just need to try and put effort. READ!!!! Most of the class is just discussion surrounding the readings that we had. Good class to take for a gen ed.
She is a very understanding and helpful professor. Class is very easy besides a few papers but any other homework you don't really have to do.

I loved the course this semester, super interesting material. Heavy participation so don't be afraid to speak, the final is a group project also which was okay if you like the people in your group, she makes sure it's fair as well.

Easily the best professor I've had here at Geneseo. She is genuinely passionate about what she's teaching and her lectures are super engaging. comment: She genuinely makes an effort to connect with students and is very understanding about medical and mental health issues from my experience. Amanda Roth is such a kind professor who really cares about her students and their overall well being, as well. She is so interesting to listen to; her passion in what she's talking about is refreshing to see, and makes listening to her ideas and questions engaging and thought-provoking.

Prof Roth is an AMAZING person. She is extremely relatable and is really open to talking about things the school does wrong. Granted, she was a tough grader on our essays but I felt like it was for the right reasons (e.g. not connecting to the course). I loved this class!

PROF. ROTH IS A TRUE GEM!!! SHE MAKES LIFE SO MUCH BETTER. def take her!!! YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT. You will never leave the classroom without learning at least 5 new things. SHE SHOULD BE A DISTINGUISHED PROF. OF PHILOSOPHY. that should say it all.

comment: Professor roth works hard to makes her course interesting and beneficial. She assigns 2-3 articles or papers for each class and uses them for class discussions. Professor Roth is honestly one of the kindest, most amazing professors I've ever had. She goes over every reading in the class and is always happy to answer questions. Excellent professor! I would definitely recommend taking a class with her if you get the chance. Dynamic and passionate about her field. have to do the reading! takes attendance!

The problem I had was that everything he taught was on the test, and it was all worth 1-2 points or so. It's a fair system, but it's difficult because you really have to prepare for literally everything.

Easily my favorite professor I've ever had. Ask questions when you don't understand something. Study class notes for exams and go to office hours or email him if you are stuck on homework problems. He tells you you will fail the exams. You are expected to have problems ready to present before material has fully been covered. Take this class with a different professor.

Heap is one of the best professors I have ever had. He cares a lot even though he pretends not to. He is a tough grader and he will push you to your limit but you will learn a lot. His classes are hard but participation is everything and you should definitely go to his office hours. I would take his class again.

Heap is a great person and professor, he is great at keeping students engaged with his humor and at making the material understandable for everyone. His office hours are very helpful. I do think that he could be a little more mindful of his types of humor, he sometimes makes me feel dumb for asking my questions. Other than this, he is really great!
Take him any chance you get especially if you are a physics major since he often teaches all the math classes that are required for that major.

comment: I really liked Heap but he didn't do enough in class examples. Luckily the SI for the course was really good and I felt like I really got the material after her sessions. Best professor I've ever had here at Geneseo. Teaches everything very well and is VERY accessible outside of class. Go to class, do the homework, study, and you will do perfectly in the class. Super funny and makes class fun. I definitely would take any class with him again.

100% would take a class with Heap again. Honestly, one of my favorite professors I've ever had. The other ratings say it all... Heap is a great professor. Very clear notes and extremely helpful.  Never rushed through problems during office hours, even when other students, in much harder classes, were waiting.

Without a doubt, Heap is the best professor in the math dept. He explains everything clearly and he makes sure you are well prepared for tests. He does give a lot of homework, but they help you a lot in preparing for tests. I would recommend any class with Heap.
Excellent professor! He loves working with his students to make sure we understand. He isn't easy and he expects us to work hard, but he helps us to succeed.

Dr. Heap is an excellent professor and probably the best in the math dept. Class is always enjoyable and you learn a lot. What can you really say about Heap? EVERYONE KNOWS HE'S THE BEST! Seriously, if there is ANY seats opened for his class, TAKE IT! He's probably the best professor I've ever had. If you have the opportunity to take any class with him, sign up immediately.

Prof. Heap is the Man! He is extremely helpful and approachable. He's got a Math Teacher sense of humor which prevents lessons from getting dull.  Homework is made mandatory by WebWorks and can get difficult at times (especially during sequences and series) but Prof. Heap is always willing to help.

Heap is an awesome professor! I took him for both calc 1 and 2. He is very clear and is extremely helpful. Homework is online so you dont need the book, and his tests are very fair! One of my favorite professors here so far, and I'm not a Math major.

Heap is a good professor for the most part. He's helpful if you ask him after class.  Usually gives extra credit too. I feel like he does a pretty good job of explaining everything. I think he's the best you will get in the math department.

Helpful, intelligent, friendly, dependable, and fast paced. It's a great class but take care not to miss it- sometimes he gives out extra credit on days when few people show up. Homework is done online.
An excellent professor,  can be difficult.  Study.  do not even bother with the book he bases the test off of the homework and lecture (do not skip class)  If you can get into his classes take it

Dr. Heap is one of the most down-to-earth, accessible professors I have had in my four years here at Geneseo. comment: One of the best professors I've had here at Geneseo so far. Very knowledgeable and teaches in a way that makes sense & is interesting. The class was graded by only two essays. I did not go to class or read anything until I started my paper and I got 90s on both of them. I put a lot of work into them though, they were not easy. comment: My favorite professor I've had in my entire time here and it's my Senior Year now. As long as you read the class is easy and he even outlines exactly how the essays should look for you. He tries to make theory fun and succeeds.

Professor McLaughin is a really nice guy but this class had a lot of reading, like at LEAST 40 pages per night. Really nice about extensions though if you ask. You're only graded on discussion posts and 2 papers which are worth 70% of your grade.

comment: Easy a because the study guides are just like the tests. Know those and you can easily get a 100 since its multiple choice and true/false. Attendance is 25% of your grade so show up and youre good. Lectures are dry, long, and a little boring. The remaining portion of your grade is 1 essay and 2 tests. Easy but again hard to sit through

I was confused pretty much the whole class. Class mandatory. I taught myself the majority of the theorists, but Dr. McLaughlin just gets wrapped up in the material thinking we all know what he is talking about. Beware of his second coming comparisons (lol), and his urge to talk about his success a lot. But he's pretty awesome, and VERY nice!

Professor McLaughlin is a true intellect! This class is very hard, but it forces you to become a great writer. He is very kind and wants to help his students. He provides many opportunities for questions and is very helpful during office hours. He even lets assignments be turned in late.

Prof. McLaughlin is honestly a great guy, he may say some things that are blatantly liberal, but he is open minded to an extent. If you go to his office hours and go to class, it should not be hard at all.

The concepts are not necessarily difficult but he's out to fail students and will find any excuse to. He's not a great lecturer, his class is boring, and group work is just another pointless section of his class. His essays aren't assigned until the later half of the semester, but then you don't get feedback in time to improve your work. DON'T TAKE

Super nice and enthusiastic about the environment. Loves class participation. Attendance is mandatory for a good grade. 3 huge papers to count for final grade no tests. He will give extensions if you ask ahead of time. Take good notes on what he says and use it for the papers. You will do fine. Super sweet man. Take it and just put effort in.

comment: Dr. McLaughlin admits classical soc isn't the most exciting thing first day of class. However, he does his best to keep students interested and sets up class discussions. comment: Graded based on attendance (25%), essay 1 (25%), essay 2 (25%), term paper (25%). I went to every class and rarely paid attention after the first few classes. 2-3 articles every night 35-40 pages. I never read them until using them as sources for essay 1 and 2. comment: Dr. McLaughlin is great! His voice is very monotonous, which can throw you off in the beginning, but he's a cool guy. Exams aren't too hard if you DO THE READINGS and look over the lectures. He's very clear with what he expects from you and even gives study guides. The essays are quite clear as well and he's always willing to help if you need it!

Incredible prof, whose passionate style and life-changing insights into the phil. of classical sociology theory stem from his sexy education. Lectures are tough to grasp bc material is heavy, but his taut lectures and helpfulness after class do help. Tests difficult, but study guides clear. Reading heavy. Two tests, two essays. 93.33 is A.

Class is VERY low energy. But if you do the readings prior to class and prepare it is manageable. Grading is average. Do what he asks and you will do fine. Go to him and ask for feedback and he is more than willing to help. Just be prepared for the second coming prophetic re-telling of the Creation Story of the Bible.
