tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS', 'LECTURE HEAVY']

comment: 5 exams before the final, drops the lowest one. SUPER FAIR &NICE GUY. I went to almost all his office hours &did problems with him that I didnt understand. The book is UNNECESSARY just do the previous exam &sample exam that he provides. He cares about your grade and really knows the material. Excellent prof, wish he taught chem118

I'm very confused where these ratings are coming from. Nothing is explained in this class. He skims through 100+ slides in a single lecture barely scratching the surface of any topic. Compared to this gen bio was ridiculously easy. The curve is so extensive that yes you can get an A, but its pretty much worthless because you don't actually learn.

Yokoyama is one of the best chemistry professors on campus, he is always there to help you. Greatest lab professor and definitely the best for Gen Chem 1. Curves a lot and very easy if you do minimal work you should be able to get a B+ easily. If you care a little, this class is an easy A-. However, it's an easy A regardless of how bright one is.

Although his pre-labs were long, he draws sketches for the procedures so you would't mess up the actual  lab. During Lab, if you needed help, he wasn't hesitant to come to you. Overall, I hated taking it Friday afternoons, but taking Lab with him made it fun!

Yokoyama is the best teacher to take for General Chemistry! All his questions come from last years exam he gives you or the sample exam he gives you. If you do both, your golden! His online quizzes are super easy and all the answers can be found, and he is very helpful at office hours!
I had Dr. Yokoyama for Chemistry Lab and he is one of the nicest Professors and funny as well. Do your work and you will pass. I would take his class again. Really enjoyed his class.

Gives plenty of opportunities to improve grade, such as an extra bonus point for going to office hours, and having 5 tests so that the lowest was dropped. Attendance was taken during class, since it is an 8:30. Notes are fill in, and are a summary, most of the time taken verbatim, from the textbook.

Tests are curved and the lowest is dropped. There are a lot of homework assignments and quizzes that are online. Don't wait until the last minute because it can take awhile. Most answers can be found online. Easiest professor for Chem 116
One of the most genuine professors you will ever meet. His pre-lab lectures are very helpful in preparing you for the lab.
Although his accent may have people tune out quickly, he is there for you if you have any questions during his office hours. TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE PRACTICE TESTS!!!!
I was so afraid to take chemistry because of bad experiences in high school. BUT IT LOVE IT. I find myself looking forward to class. AMAZING TEACHER.

Yoko is a little hard to understand because of his accent. Very easy to tune out and not pay attention. Provided a ton of hep during office hours and really cares about students. Test questions are taken directly from sample exam and the final is questions from the tests but with different values.

Yoko is such a great teacher for your first college level chemistry class. Spend time on the online homework and you'll get a good grade. Tests can be tricky, definitely find older versions and DO THE PRACTICE TESTS!

Dr. Yoko is hilarious and a really nice guy. Pay attention in lecture and do the practice tests.  A lot of test questions are straight from the Sample Exam or the online quizzes. Don't leave the quizzes till the last minute - they can take hours if you don't know the material very well. He appreciates if you go to review and sit in the front row.

I highly recommend Prof Yokoyama for Chem 1. He has lots of office hours, holds in-class and out-of-class review sessions (go to the out-of-class ones!), gives at least two sample exams for each test (do these and you will get a good grade!!!), and drops your lowest test. The online quizzes are a bit tricky and an A is set at a 95, which is tough.

He is my favorite teacher at Geneseo. He is the perfect example of what & how a professor should be. Despite the large class size he knows who you are, recognizes & acknowledges hard workers. He is straight forward - No matter what, you definitely have to teach yourself some material, but fear not, because Yoko is the most welcoming person ever.

His class is really easy. I never went to the actually class itself. I just looked up the power point online, and read the textbook. If you do the sample exams, you'll get an A. He also drops your lowest test!

Had to teach myself a lot, his accent was extremely difficult for me, and with only fill in the blank packets, I found it difficult to pay attention and learn anything from him. Most of the learning was done out of my book!

How could anyone dear to give this man less than a 5 for easiness? You will not find an easier teacher in the science department. Generous curves, and lectures are simplified to a 1st grade level. Fantastic, funny professor. Perfect for Chem 1.

Such an amazing chemistry professor!! Really understands what he is talking about.. From time to time he cracks jokes in class. Read textbooks, and understand quizzes and sample exams and you will be fine!! His curves are also very generous!! Best chemistry professor EVER!!
Great Professor, although I hardly went to class I got a B without the textbook. He gives homework which is extreamly helpful and DO THE PRACTICE TEST, test questions mimic these almost exactly!!!!!

The BEST professor I've had at Geneseo. He really does out of his way for his students and actually cares for his students. His accent can be kind of tricky, but he is funny enough that he makes fun of it. As long as you use his lecture slides, it should be a pretty easy class -- plus, he curves and drops lowest exam! He's literally the best.

I could never understand a word that came out of Yokoyama's mouth. His notes/ lectures are easy enough to understand, but actually reading the book was extremely helpful.  As long as you have a good grip on the material his tests won't be too difficult.  Homework and quizzes are online and are easy.

Chemistry is not an easy class and does require lots of self teaching. Yoko does not really do many example problems in class, however, tests are pretty straight forward, and often questions are directly off of sample exams. Do the work and you will get an A, slack and you won't.

I recommend him to anyone! Has good slides and great notes!He gives a lot of homework quizzes and 5 tests but all give you more opportunities to improve grade. Tests are multiple choice later on and also the final.Got an A-, originally thinking I would fail. Also don't be afraid of office hrs. Hes very nice. He also gives practice tests for exams!

Yoko is a really nice & funny person but not very personable in his "100" classes. If you try really hard, you'll probably get him to know you. His powerpoints and notes are very clear but you MUST read. That is the best way to make it through his exams. He goes faster than the other Chem. classes Overall, not a bad choice & accent is not that bad.

Great professor!! highly recommended. very helpful during office hours, unlike most professors at geneseo. highly knowledgeable, clear notes. accent is not a big deal, people just use that as an excuse! take his class! it's awesome.

I love Yoko! He is one the BEST and most helpful professors. He posts hints for the homework assignments and will help you complete them during office hours. He tells you almost exactly what is on the exam. He is very generous with curving and since homework is worth 40% of the grade, it is impossible to get anything less than a B+. TAKE HIM.
Not a bad professor. Had clear powerpoints, and told you what you needed to know for tests. Couldnt understand him unless you really paid attention. Nice guy a pretty good professor.
He is the coolest guy ever! His teaching was really fun and easy. The way he grade was fair. If you don't understand something, hes always welcome for his office hours.
he's a really nice professor. he's helpful and his powerpoints are clear. he tells you what to study. probably the best professor i've had.

Seriously, the best professor i've had yet. He goes above and beyond to help you understand the material. If you attend class, and pay attention, you'll do fine. If you don't understand something, he's very welcoming during office hours and will help you until you know the material by heart.

He's one to avoid! Really bad at teaching and his tests are almost always harder than material covered in the textbook. Even studying the practice questions doesn't help much. Also tries to embarrass and turn students against each other.

I had him for the chem103 lab.  the lecture sucks, but the lab is pretty easy.  Kazu is funny and approachable but his thick accent sometimes makes him slightly incomprehensible.  The labs are pretty easy to get 100's on but I don't feel like I'm retaining too much of the information so the final might be bad news. He's nice, the lab part is easy.

Chemistry is an interesting subject, but this class was boring. I often found it impossible to understand what he was saying - he has a thick accent. I didn't think his powerpoints (used every class) were very good either. Studying the book is the easiest way to learn the material. I skipped class a lot
He's a very funny guy, and very nice. If chem isn't your strongest subject, he still makes it manageable and somewhat enjoyable.

Kazu is a great professor. The online homework sucks, but he will help you immensely with it if you ever need help. The tests are hard but as long as you do the sample exam and and study it it's not all bad. The online quizzes(the second one is brutal) are not bad either. Go to office hours and he'll start to really like you :)

Not one of my preferred instructors.  Near incomprehensible speech and a riduculous amount of homework made the class unpleasent.  The homework is almost impossibe at times and it takes at least 15+hours a week.  Tests are ridiculous and he gives multiple formulas we do not use. Not a bad proffesor, just unsuited for a freshman class.
He puts random pictures in slideshows and brings simple toys to demonstrate chemistry concepts.
He rocks!! He is funny, interesting, and approachable. He knows what he is talking about, and his sense of humor gets the class going. I highly recommend his class.

he is a VERY nice guy and is very understandable and funny, however i found it practically impossible to keep up with his MasteringChemistry assignments which took me on average a minimum of 10 hours each week. it is very easy to get him to postpone due dates, however that doesnt always help.

he is a really sweet guy, but his accent makes it impossible to pay attention to him, especially at 8:30 in the morning. and the online homework is SO annoying...so much, i feel like you would have to sit and only do that to get it completed.

He wasn't necessarily the greatest professor in my opinion but I found the online homework and the lectures pretty difficult to understand at times. I just didn't like the fact that everything was technology-based. I do better when I'm physically writing notes, not when I'm reading them. He's funny and very approachable.

very nice guy, knows his stuff but doesn't necessarily explain it the best, OWLs are a pain but it's part of the course so you deal with it, his tests have multiple choice exactly the same as the practice tests, he gives out bonus points all the time and will postpone due dates very easily with enough persuasion
greaast

This guy is amazing. I loved his class!! He's an all around amazing guy, but get used to him saying "extra credit"-9 times out of 10, he's joking around. One thing that sucks are the OWLs-they're tedious

This class was a joke.  Yoko is a nice guy.  80 % of every test was identical to the 7 or 8 problems we had for homework throughout the entire 1/4 of the semester!  I think our class average is above a 90.  Easiest 300 level chem class I could ever imagine
Two Words.  He rocks.

He's a cool, nice, and decent professor. My main complaint is that I feel it was too easy for some people to get an A in the class. He curves up A LOT, gives A LOT of extra credit, and then curves everything else on top of that. The only other complaint I have is that he's a bit unclear at times because of his accent, but it rarely affects hisclass

comment: One of my favorite professors at Geneseo! If you go to class he will make you laugh, and a genuinely kind guy. Brings in surprises every one in a while to change class up and really engages students. 10/10.

Sargent was one of the best professors I have had at Geneseo. He really considers that all people have to take HUMN, even if they aren't interested in it. All you have to do is show up to class. Minimal papers. Reading assignments for HW. Respects you as a student and your time. I can not say enough great things about this professor.

This class was honestly one of the most interesting and easy classes I've taken at Geneseo. Everyone dreads taking HUMN but I got lucky when I signed up for this class. He knows nobody wants to take the class but he makes it so fun and the papers are easy As. Sargent is an AMAZING professor. I withdrew from HUM twice before taking it with him and he literally makes it interesting to read about Marx, Shelley, Locke and anyone else! He is truly amazing. Sign up for his class.

I looked forward to coming to class every day. Lectures are very informative and entertaining. He cares a lot about his students and the class material, which is reflected in how he engages with the class.
Dr. Sargent is a great professor and makes lectures entertaining. A quiz for participation every class engages students in the material. Great class to take, highly recommended
Great Prof and an Easy Course, Very Kind and Understanding with students needs.

A great professor that makes learning humanities interesting. The class was twice a week so it was 90 minutes and I was never bored or falling asleep. He also was very accommodating throughout the semester as I was going through job recruitment season.

I had to take this course to graduate so I was not looking forward to it. He breaks the class into parts, so there is group work, a short video, quizes and Lecture. I found him engaging and ended up paying attention. Best of the Humn Profs? in the top 3 for sure.

the nicest and most enthusiastic professor. definitely worth waiting to take hum if you cannot get into this class.
Good class

Worst professor I have ever had. She is so beyond unclear and gives the most pointless assignments that don't help at all. She is rude over email and gives unnecessary assignments. Not helpful. Just overall terrible, disorganized, and unclear professor. Would not recommend under any circumstance.

assignments are unclear, theres always like 4 projects due on one day, not good if your uncomfortable speaking in front of people. loads of group projects that she gives you about 2 days to do. honestly take with another teacher. crazy work load on top of already crazy schedule.

Very nice professor. you got a LOT of work to do, but every assignment is defin useful. You did every report, assignment, memo, letters in Google drive, and she will keep editing it for you. It is very useful. I feel I learned a lot from this class.

awful teacher! do not take a class with him unless you want anxiety

comment: Great professor, would recommend
The best professor I have had at my time at Geneseo. :)

Towsley is a god of mathematics. He explains things clearly, and precisely! He also is a professional at the Putnam exam, and Im sure will score a 120! If you are thinking of becoming a math major, take Towsley!

Dr. Towsley is the best professor I've ever had. If you have a chance to take a class with him you definitely should do it. He's both brilliant and understanding. If you come to him he will work with you to make sure that you understand the material and do well.

comment: Professor Towsley was amazing!! His class was very straight forward. You always knew what was expected of you. The tests were very fair along with the final. Towsley is an amazing professor. He teaches in a manner where it is easy enough to learn and understand what you are learning. A MUST TAKE.

great teacher! heavily recommend this class because its easier than calc222, homework being turned in anytime the day it is due is great, and really forces you to try! test are extremely fair and everything is covered min class! easily best professor i've had at geneseo

comment: Geiger is honestly, one of the best teachers I have ever had at Geneseo. Orgo is hard, regardless who you take, but she's very dedicated and so helpful during office hours. comment: Really a fantastic class. While on the surface development politics seems a little dry, the class really exposed me to the meaning of the word "politics" in a way I was not before. This one class taught me more about political science than any other. Lucas was a little awkward, but I feel that his class is the only politics class of real substance

I wish we would have spent some more time focusing on conflict resolution, but I feel like I learned a lot about civil wars. Actually, I think I learned more in this class than in any other polysci class I've taken.

This class was super difficult, especially as a gen-ed.  The reading load was simply too much, and the class actually covers more economics than politics.  He gives pop quizzes after impossibly long readings and just acts mildly annoyed when the whole class fails.  He never curves, and the material is dry as hell. 1/10 would not recommend.

The absolute worst. I am a transfer student and having him on day 1 scared me. His voice is really annoying and requires you to read about 100+ pages a week. Attendance wasn't part of your grade and notes were online. If you just need a M/ credit,  I suggest avoiding this class.

He makes you read excessive amounts of the textbooks, and just re-hashes the readings in class.  The class title is a misnomer; it's all about politics and development. He forces you into discussion groups with random kids for the whole semester, so it's a nightmare for introverts.  Avoid this class like the plague.

Honestly, he's a pretty nice teacher and wants you to do well. He's pretty open to office hours and if you have a question on an assignment he's willing to help. The reading load is heavy. Sometimes the material is dry, at least in my opinion, but it helps out so you know what's going on in class.

I believe that Prof. Lucas genuinely wants his students to do well in his class and he does a good job of encouraging people to participate in class.  The reading load was pretty heavy, but the essay assignments and the final exam weren't too hard.

I had prof Bullinger at Oneonta and I had a good experience. He gives manageable work and I like the way he did online because it makes this class much better. I had him as an 8:30 class and for a class that early it wasn't bad. He is a nice guy and will always give feedback if you need help. If you are taking public speaking I definitely recommend

I took a class with Professor Bullinger at SUNY Oneonta and he was a nice guy but tough grade for no real reason. I took public speaking with him and he told me he was grading me harder than the rest of the class because I was a sophomore, which I thought was unfair. Overall he was a nice guy but if you're looking for an easy grade stay away.

Bullinger is not an intelligent man. He's very elitist and pretentious with his language, but when it comes down to it he's a bad communicator. Every time he gives feedback or responds to student commentary I think "THAT's what you got from that?" Totally off-base and very obviously filtered through his own preconceptions. Shockingly out of touch.

This guy deserves to teach at Harvard or something

I recommend taking his class. He is very passionate about teaching/ the information he is teaching. Although the class requires a lot of outside reading, it prepares you well for the next class discussion. He is very open to comments and/or questions and wants the best for his students.
Bullinger is the man. Knows what he's talking about, passionate about his students and the subjects he teaches, overall cool dude.

very good

Great teacher. She seemed eh in the beginning, but she really grows on you. Really understanding and not a bad class at all with her.

I LOVE O'Brien! I had her every semester and each time was a GREAT experience! I've learned so much from her. She is extremely helpful and makes class interesting and fun. Dr. O'Brien was very helpful and insightfull while taking classes from her. Throughout my whole experience at Geneseo I have never come accross a professor that has been more genuine and outgoing as Dr. O'Brien. I would reccomend her to any student.

With this in mind all you have to do is go to class, study the exams, ask questions and repetition is key. Not a free A but it can definitely be earned! Also he curves!

In class he will take extreme amounts of time explaining very obvious concepts and stop to make bad jokes. The R isn't bad- just read directions and go to office hours.

comment: He is one of those professors who thinks he's funny, and then there are those people who suck up to him like crazy. There are very little grades so everything is worth a lot. Think twice before taking this course with him.

It's difficult to put into words how great of an impact Dr. Hartvigsen had an effect on me he taught me in undergrad. His passion for the use of computational biology and programming is infectious and led me into an incredible career. He's a brilliant lecturer, and a wonderful human. Do yourself a favor and take a class with him.

Dr. H is so caring and really wants you to succeed in ecology and biology in general. He is super approachable in and out of the class. Overall, he is on the best profs I've taken at Geneseo!!

SUCH a sweet guy. Great professor and leads very interesting lectures. He teaches very R heavy with little instruction but if you go to office hours, the R homeworks are easy! Gives extra credit assignments and questions on every test. Super personable and understanding. Gives some group pop quizzes that you WILL get 100s on. HIGHLY recommend!!

Fantastic teacher. Hilarious and makes lectures very laid back, almost conversational. He is a nice person, but Biodata Analysis was a ridiculous class. We are graded on such few things, most of them being at the end of the semester. comment: Dr. Hartvigsen is by far the best professor I've had/probably will ever have. He is so impressively intelligent, while also being down-to-earth and helpful. Choose this class over an "easy-A"!! Lectures are very interesting, math-heavy but not horrible. There is a lot of R, but he is so willing to help. Hard tests, but not impossible!
Take the class. Any class, Biology, Ecology, it doesn't matter. This is the best professor I have every had at Geneseo. You won't regret it, I promise.

Dr. H is one of the best professors you could ever have here. Not only are his lectures entertaining and interactive, he is one of the most approachable people on campus. He really truly wants all of his students to succeed in ecology and biology and will help any way he can especially in office hours. Would suggest always reading the textbook!

One of my favorite professors ever. I think people are scared to take eco with him bc of R, but there are only 3 homeworks with R and they are grade boosters bc TA's are there to help you. He gives you all his old tests to look at and that helps a lot with tests

Harvigsen was my favorite professor and really got me interested in Ecology. His lectures are bit scattered but are definitely entertaining. He isnt afraid to joke around and mess with the students, especially when teaching the topics he enjoys. I would definitely take him again and I am taking data analysis only because he is teaching it

Love Hartvigsen. He's really smart, a little wacky and blunt, and makes class interesting. Makes the course tough, but gives you everything you need to succeed and lays it all out.

comment: Love Hartvigsen, he's a mix of a being really cool and at the same time really smart and a little awkward. Expect to do a lot of modeling and R with him--he literally wrote the book on R that the college uses for intro bio lab.  Tests are very reasonable and ecology modules (R homeworks) clearly laid out with a lot of help available.

Hartvigsen is one of the best professors at Geneseo!  Make sure you show up to class and take good notes in addition to slides.  He gives you the book. Go to office hours w questions, he is always super helpful!  R modules can be tough but if you go to the tutor they are doable.  Class always put me in a good mood; he is super funny and chill

Best and most useful class I've ever taken at Geneseo. If you have the choice between this and another, easier stats course, take this. You will certainly give up the easy A by taking this class, but you have a chance to get an A in a class that will undoubtedly help in the long run!

The best professor I've ever had at Geneseo. Great and interesting lectures that are also funny! I learned so much from him, and his organization of the class is excellent. If you want to learn a lot, work a good amount, and really enjoy coding--TAKE THIS CLASS!

Hartvigsen is the best! His lectures are very engaging and he makes the class very fun. If you ever have a question just go to his office hours (and get there early, he's very popular)!

TAKE HIS CLASS! Fantastic! Lectures are fascinating. Hilarious, passionate, caring, helpful; an all around great guy! He provides textbook. Don't skip! Cute too :)

R modules are really hard, if you don't know R, you will have a hard time. He has his own textbook and he doesn't test much from them.

He is the best instructor I have had thus far. Don't take the class with him if you are looking for an easy A. Tests are tough! But I genuinely enjoyed his lectures. He is an interesting guy! He's very helpful if you go to office hours. Don't be afraid to ask questions. It'll probably have a significant effect on your grade. And DON'T skip classes!

Majority of this class seems like an extension of Bio205: tested little on ecology and mostly on R. If you don't know R well, you won't do well. Cool person, but needs better organization as a teacher

very intellegent guy. knows everything about statistics. learning R is difficult but he does a good job teaching it.
wasnt event a science major- was a bio minor.  this class was soooooo easy.  if you cant do well in this course ur an idiot.  hartvigsen is pretty cool too.

comment: Will teach something in class and right away except her students to be masters of the subject and how it can interact with previous material without explaining how and why. She is passive aggressive towards her students and cant understand why one section did worse than the other. Quizzes are difficult with most of the questions with many answers

comment: Do not take class with this professor. She is one of the worst i have taken. She is very passive aggressive when students ask questions believing that once she says something she doesn't have to repeat herself. Also, when she does answer a question she just raises her voice loudly. She has no respect towards her students and that some are verybusy

Prof. Varghese is very unapproachable outside of class and has difficulty clearly explaining topics to students. Had trouble responding to emails quickly. Will never curve or give any extra credit- doesn't believe in giving students points "they don't deserve". Her grading is extremely hard and tests are tricky. Would not recommend.

The best way to succeed in this class is to do the practice sheets that Dr. Varghese posts online. These problems are very similar in difficulty to what she expects you to be able to do on tests. Her tests can be tricky because she combines multiple concepts to make up a single question, but they are definitely doable. You 100% get what you put in

comment: While it's certainly difficult to do well in this class, it's not impossible. My biggest suggestion would be to do the readings well in advance. Her answers to questions aren't clear if you don't know the material already (which defeats the purpose of asking a question). Know the readings inside and out, watch youtube videos and you'll be fine.

comment: Nisha has difficulty explaining any topics to her students. Asking questions rarely helps as she simply repeats what she just said but louder. Her tests were pretty hard overall and almost always were heavily based off concepts we learned literally the class before.
Avoid taking organic chemistry with her. She's very unclear about what she expects, and makes the test difficult. No curving or extra credit offered.

comment: Doggett is smarter than you'll ever be, and he knows it. I took his Poetics 203 class, and even though I don't care for poetry, I found his lectures beneficial. Lots of reading and discussion. Exams are cumulative and high stress (imo). He's a great professor.
tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Gives good feedback']

comment: I personally really like the discussions we have in this class, and I feel like I'm actually learning things I've never heard of before. I feel like I'm learning more perspective and how to think better. He's kind of like a funny grumpy old man.
hes very personable and kind. he really tries his best to be a good mentor even though he goes on a million side tangents during class.

Dr Doggett is an amazing professor, I always try to take his classes when I can. His passion for teaching makes learning enjoyable, and he encourages students to think and ask questions. He is very knowledgeable and dedicated, which makes his classes some of the best I've taken.

I liked him a lot but he goes off topic so quickly making his lectures so boring. There are not slides and he just talks at you for hours and moves rather quickly through concepts. He is very flexible about the midterm and final exam and gives super detailed feedback on papers. I would not recommend taking this class if you do not have to though.
tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Participation matters', 'Gives good feedback']

comment: Doggett's absolutely hilarious, a genuinely good dude. He is super personable and gives amazing feedback on papers. Almost intimidatingly smart, but a great professor. He holds you accountable and his class isn't easy, but you will learn a ton. Definitely take a class with him at least once in your time here.

One of my favorites! When a class I needed was taught by him, I would work to make it fit in my schedule. He tends to ramble a little, but he very entertaining and has an enjoyable wit. He is obviously knowledgeable in his field, a true intellectual. He gives great feedback and works with students to improve class, can be reading and essay heavy.

Very very funny guy, this class is just an intro the the english major so it's pretty much nothing but he gives good advice and tells hilarious stories about his life. You only do one writing assignment a week and it's cool to see a different side of the professors.
Professor Doggett is a kind and caring man. This class was to help freshman find their major, and the class was extremely helpful and fun. It was also very easy.

Rob is great. He truly wants all of his students to do well. The readings he assigns can be long and boring but he does not expect much of you in class. He goes over the readings in class and wants to hear what you have to say and know how you feel. He gives great feedback and really wants you to improve in your writing. He is very caring.

This class is experimental, but it did help me a little bit. Prof. Doggett was funny and serious. He was very open about himself and his life journey, which I think was the most helpful thing for this "first year seminar". I definitely appreciated this class and the work done for it. It is a 1/2 sem. class and it doesn't hurt to take it.

Very thorough and helpful feedback. Great and engaging lectures that made English literary techniques more clear and defined. Good at engaging with students in class. Wanted feedback on the class at the end of the year, indicating a willingness to strive. Really nice guy and had a good time in class.

Rob is pretty amazing. I hope you like Ireland and existential crises because he sure does. He has the best sense of dry humor. He's too smart for his own good. He'd rather be in a smokey pub day-drinking and taking poetry with other middle-aged men, but he also makes a very good professor. I've taken too many classes with him at this point.

doggett is pretty alright. spent two weeks studying dead poets society and how everyone in the movie is gay. He really loves Ireland if you're in to that. the midterm and test are rouGh lemme tell ya. he has a fairly decent dry sense of humor so on occasion you'll chuckle. On the last day he told us that everything he taught us isn't real.

Dr. Doggett is easily the smartest professor I have ever had. He is extremely knowledgeable about the material and very helpful if you are struggling. He gives very detailed notes on essays which made me a better writer overall. I highly recommend his class, he made me remain an English major.

"Inspirational" isn't really the word I would use, but he is the SMARTEST man I have ever met in my life. Smart to the extent that I could not really comprehend what he was saying. His work is essay-based, there were no tests. Participate in class, as he looks for that. And read the material, otherwise you'll fail. Seriously.

Doggett writes long and specific responses to each paper, which I really liked and have never experienced with another professor. This was really useful in improving each paper that I wrote from the last. He also encourages stimulating discussions that make going to class easy. I've learned more in this class than any other I've taken.

I LOVE Dr. Doggett. His class was so interesting and inspired me to stay with my English major. He is very well educated and has a wide-range of knowledge, which he is willing to share with the class. Very funny and interesting, but easy to be intimidating. Tough grader, but you will come out better because of it.

Get past his arrogance and you'll be alright. He likes to hear himself talk. Clear authority complex, but definitely knows what he's talking about. His favorite line: "Yeah, yeah. I think that's right." Writing papers for him is discouraging, but if you go to his office hours and demonstrate interest (or fake it) he'll be more than willing to help.

My favorite professor at Geneseo. He's the type of guy you want to grab a beer with & sit around & listen to him talk just for fun. He is very intelligent - doesn't hesitate to explain or offer extra help after class. Goes above and beyond for his students just make sure to always go to class and participate. That is why you're in college, right?

Doggett's dry humor was definitely entertaining and he was very helpful during office hours. He is a good professor but sometimes the things he talks about are based on his own philosophical assumptions. I would recommend him for Humn but keep in mind that he looks for good writing and participation in class.

Easily the best professor I have had at Geneseo. He is extremely brilliant and really passionate about his profession. Hilarious too! I always enjoy going to class, knowing I will learn a lot and have a good laugh. Great guy.

Brilliant, enthusiastic professor that every English major or minor should take at least once. Reading Ulysses in his Joyce class is truly enjoyable, and you can tell he cares deeply about what he's teaching. Expects students to keep up with the reading, but you're in college, come on. Fair in grading and very helpful all around

got an A but had to work my a.. off! hardest ENG class i've ever taken—including 300 levels. if you're looking for an easy A, take someone else. but, if you want to be a better academic writer, take Doggett. CONS: heavy workload, harsh grader, very opinionated. PROS: reciprocal of respect & you'll get your $'s worth when it comes to your education!

Dr. Doggett is brilliant and will work with you if you don't understand something. He's extremely patient and doesn't call people out for being stupid even when they deserve it. He takes students and grades seriously-- effective in boosting writing/critical thinking skills. I've taken 2 poetry classes with him and would definitely take him again!

Doggett is a cool guy. He seems intimidating at first, but once you sit in his class you realize he's got quite the sense of humor. Expect a lot of homework! He's a tough grader, but he does want to see everyone do well. Attend the class though, most of the grades comes from responses and quizzes!I would take another class with him.

He really cares about what he teaches. I was always very interested in everything he said. He is passionate about English and he wants you to be also. Just make sure you really put work into what you write, I met with him before every major paper and got As on both. His TA will grade your minor response papers, but they helped boost my grade a lot.

Ok heres the deal rob's a cool guy super helpful with anything and everything, but a VERY tough grader. He tells you class average is a C and there is a great deal of reading 50-100 pgs per class. If you do the work and pay attention you'll learn a lot but not necessarily do well.

He's a great professor, very interested in what he's teaching. Really helped me improve my essay writing in the end, but he tore my essays to shreds, no matter how many weeks in advance I worked on them.

Best professor I've ever had.  Intelligent, funny, and eloquent.  Very down to Earth.  Receptive to the ideas of students. 2 essays and a final; he is somewhat of a tough grade, but provides excellent typed analyses of your work.  The amount of reading was a little much, usually 80+ pages per class, but it is well worth it.

Doggett knows his subject, and is very explicit in what he expects of students. He's a tough grader, but it's easy to do well if you master the material. His classroom is political, but he presents very good reasons for teaching the way he does.  Makes you very aware of teaching styles, in relation to prevalent contemporary approaches to English.

Awesome class, engaging and funny. never dreaded going to class. wish he was teaching Hum II. Daily quizzes aren?t bad, I read 2/3 of the time and sparknoted the rest.  Great class, highly recommended if you are a decent writer for the 2 papers and can draw some conclusions on your own for the two exams.

Easily one of the smartest men I've ever met. He is a really, really tough grader on papers... With that being said, he offers all kinds of help outside of class and wants to see you succeed and grow as a writer. His feedback is amazing, he literally types a page for each student explaining how they can improve on major papers. I learned so much.

Rob Dog is the man.  He made the texts interesting and provided a higher level of analysis than I've gotten out of any other professor- regardless of discipline.  His assignments are fair and reasonable; they require good class attendance and reading the texts. If students do the work, the class is rewarding and exciting.

One of the worst professors I've ever had the misfortune of knowing.  He was not helpful whatsoever, and only respects people who have the same opinion as him.  Constantly tells people that they are wrong just because he disagrees with them.  I will NEVER have him as a professor again.

He's extremely intelligent and has a great personality, but he's very difficult... you're expected to do a ton of reading and understand them. MUST attend class!!! he's a very hard grader, i still got an A-, but i worked my butt off.

An amazing professor if you are willing to put the effort in.  All of the reading is necessary for the class participation which will boost your grade a LOT..so attendance is a must as well.  Despite the workload and hard grading, Doggett is fair, open minded and a great guy.  I learned a lot from him. =)

Dr.Doggett is a great prof! It sucks that everyone has to take humn, but i would def recommend doing it with him! He made an 8 am class actually enjoyable! Its a hard class and a lot of work, but he is by far the best i've had so far!

Doggett is one of the more interesting professors on campus,and is usually pretty brilliant.Perceptive, open minded, helpful, hilarious, charming, self aware, self deprecating, and confident all at the same time. Not a pansy (don't let the monogrammed shirt fool you).

Rob Doggett is amazing.  Not only is he hot.  He's also completely sarcastic (in a really funny way).  I've taken a few English classes with him so far and I'm never disappointed.  He makes me want to attend class, even at 8 in the morning.  He is a tough grader but he's fair.  My favorite professor by FAR

Dr. Doggett is awesome!! If you do the reading you will do fine on his assignments, and the papers, as long as you put in the effort, you will do well. He makes himself very available for help with papers and is in general very fair. His classes are entertaining, and overall I would totally recommend taking his class!

Completely full of himself, boastful, and a bit rude.  Not to mention he's a bit of a pansy.  I can't stand this guy.  Also, puts way too much emphasis on Yeats.  I get that he likes him, but there are other poets in the world!

Class can get kinda boring but he gives a 5 min. break. He likes to joke around a lot which helps you get through the early morning class. Grades papers like everyone is an English major but is pretty fair overall.

tough grader on papers, but if you read and attend class and speak up once in a while its fairly easy.  tests are straight forward, whatever he writes on the board will be on the test and are very important to remember.  He likes to talk alot, but is a pretty good teacher.

Had him for Irish Theory and Lit. Personally, I hated the subject, thought it was real boring. He took attendance and made it count for 20% which sucked because I didn't like to go and sit there and listen about crap I didn't read. Funny guy though. Class seemed really enjoyable for those around me...

Doggett is a funny guy.  This class was always interesting--we read great books that were all new to me and he would do his best to make class entertaining.  It might not be an easy A but if you're an eng major than you should know a good professor is more worthwhile than an easy grade.
pretty dreamy.... like, the brooding, Heathcliff kind...

He seems nice n' all, but I dunno. Whenever I've gone up to him he seemed kinda stuck up and mean... which is kinda awkward. He's sorta creepy, but he says some funny stuff once in awhile. Not enough grades though... I still haven't gotten my paper back (handed it in like 2 months ago)

Really knows his stuff, helpful if you seek it out, and great in class. Careful, however, he likes the sound of his own voice (in the sense that he'll read passages in this whisper-like voice...) and if as a class you guys don't think he's the funniest guy, he may not love you. Laugh at his jokes, do the reading and you'll be fine.
I think I fell in love with him.  The class was very interesting.

His class flew by everyday.  I'd just sit down and it seemed like the class was over.  Not a boring moment.  The other students got into the class too.  This professor loves his subject and cares about his students.  He is a great guy and a great teacher.  I had no idea who he was when I signed up for his class, but I'm sure glad I did.

Very helpful guy. Had him for writing and actually learned to write a little better. Doesn't screw around with grading, you may struggle. However, he writes a full page for you after every paper about what you did well or did wrong. Cool guy and fun stories. Take him if you want to learn and don't mind a bit of work.
Good guy all-around.

I love love love this professor.  Funny and teaches a great lesson.  The class is over in no time and I don't mind getting up for it.  Most people say they hate humn but I love.  He makes it pretty easy to get a good grade: do the reading (which he cuts down), write 10 short responses (1 page) and come to class.  I'm so glad gambled with Doggett.
Class on Ireland was great last semester. Carries on very interesting class discussions. Agreed with everyone else on the difficult grading, but it's constructive.
Extremely well versed in the subject (Yeats and Heaney).  A fair guy, he just wants you to work for him.  Show up, talk and actually write your paper and youll do fine.
A difficult course. He does enhance his students writing quite a bit, but at the expense of their GPA's.  Don't take it hoping for an easy A - but it is interesting and you learn a lot.

Very hard on grading.  Not an easy A.  If you are looking for someone who will take time to really read your paper and give lots of feedback, take a class with him.  If looking for the easy A that most Freshman writing courses are, try to avoid.  He is a nice guy though and knows a lot in the subject area.  Very focused on bettering you as a studen

You pretty much have to be a charles dickens to get an A on a paper in this class. He is more worried about you "learning" then getting a good grade so you know a C is fine. He is Very bias, and contradicts himself.....He only gave out 1!!! A in the class, ONE!!!!!

Very very hard grader. Nearly impossible to get an A in that class. Its a intro class its supposed to be easy but he's an idealist who thinks that everyone should become an incredible writer. very biased and not an interesting class

Dr. McKnight is a nice person outside of lectures, however in class the lectures often exceed scheduled class time and are filled with tangents that don't mean anything to the course itself. Quizzes are the length of exams & exams the length of finals. The most niche questions will be asked and you will be lost if you don't pay attention in class.

Professor McKnight is one of the hardest chem graders I have ever had during my time at Geneseo. Take orgolab with either duran or barnabas if you want to get a decent grade. McKnight makes grading errors, gives points of for little things that don't matter.

He is a good professors with just about "weekly" quizzes or jeopardy sessions. His quizzes are based on lectures but you do not need to attend in order to get a good grade as he posts all his lecture recordings on brighspace. He also heavily bases his exams on his quizzes so if you use his videos and old quizzes to study you will do fine.

He is a tough grader and doesn't clearly communicate his expectations. He is a stickler when grading lab reports and you can never include enough information. Very condescending to talk to & makes a clear effort to make you feel dumb. If you're a female he is guaranteed to talk down to you. Clearly very intelligent but definitely not my cup of tea.

comment: Dr. Mcknight is the coolest guy in geneseo, his lecture takes forever but lab is a great time.

He's very picky with grading and expects us to know everything that comes out of his mouth. The problem comes from the fact that it's impossible to retain everything he says. Honestly, felt like he didn't care about his students. Take cell bio lab instead, you'll thank yourself. I thought I was in hell during this lab.
Currently in his Monday section, and feels like hell sometimes. Completely unhelpful and his office hours are useless. Doesn't give us what he wants. Unfortunately he's the only one teaching lab.

McKnight is very intelligent throughout the fields of chemistry, but his instructing is unsuccessful. Try to avoid. Not impossible to get an A, but involves intense dedication. I only got an A because I took AP Chem in high school. Has a thick accent and can be unclear in lecture. Go to lecture EVERY DAY. Don't skip!! Textbook is very necessary.
It's a hard class no matter who teaches it but he is hard to follow along with during lecture and isn't helpful in office hours.

He has probably been one of the most unhelpful professors I have err had. He did not stick to the syllabus when it comes to what is on certain quizzes and tests. He takes 30 minutes to explain what the textbook says in one sentence. I went to his office hours looking for help, and he turned me away saying "this is easy you already know this"

McKnight is sometimes quite hard to understand and his lectures are not exciting. He tries to make jokes, but they aren't effective. He is a nice guy, but his instructing skills are a bit off. If you take any Chemistry class with him, make sure you come in with an already large understanding of the subject and you should get an A with some work.
Yes he is tough at times, but come on guys this is college. anyways, great professor. Now as a doctor myself, I look back and remember his teaching the most. Thank you

Professor Mcknight is a very condescending professor. He is unwilling to assist students during office hours especially pertaining to specific questions. He flies through the material and sometimes gives quizzes and exams on slideshows that were never taught in lecture. Don't take his class.

He is a hard grader and I would not recommend taking him! He has a different grading scale and weighting than the other orgo lab professors. He is very hard to understand at times, especially with the fume hoods going all the time. It wasn't horrible, but it wasn't an easy A.

Dr. McKnight was at times very confusing. He tends to fly through the material and he doesn't take the time to go through the difficult material which was problematic. Can come off as uninterested and arrogant.

His accent is very heavy and he is not easily understood at all. He is also very condescending and not helpful in his office hours. Lean towards the air of precaution if you are considering taking his class.

Difficult to do well in this class, points are taken off for the smallest things and he sometimes comes off as condescending. You can never include enough information for the abstracts/lab reports to be adequate.

Best professor to take lab with! He will help you a lot in the beginning as you get accustomed to lab. Of course you need to have an idea of what you're doing, but he is def easy to approach and a great personality to have lab with. Take him!!

He gives you everything you need to pass the class. There's a lot of homework and its pretty boring but if you do it you'll do fine. A very good guy to talk to if you ever attend his office hours, I would take a class with him again as long as it wasn't lecture style.

Hes boring and his examples are useless. You're going to learn most of the subject material on your own through masteringchem... His accent is really distracting when youre trying to do hw in class. He doesnt post his slides until after class... Pretty useless teacher in my opinion. Tests, depends on how well you understand relationships nd luck...
This guy is the man, man. I feel like I am in a caribbean island drinking a malibu rum punch when I'm in this class. McKnight is makes it awesome it's the place to be

I personally didn't like Dr. McKnight even though i did well in his lab. He is very confusing...tells you about 65% of what he wants in your lab report, but the other 25% you're just suppose to  magically "know". He's hard to understand because of his accent and stutter. He is, however, a very nice man and helpful in other aspects.
McKnight is clear about what he wants and is very helpful! TAKE HIM for orgo lab. Pretty reasonable grader too.
At first, I couldnt stand him; I felt quickly judged. Overtime I adjusted and he became one of my favorite proffesors.  Very personable guy and is quite helpfull. Likes to see students improve
very passionate about the subject, and is extremely helpful during office hours. really hard class tho
McKnight does a good job of teaching Chem 100 and letting the students get to know the chemistry department...  He's also very pleasant to work with if you have any questions..

I liked Dr. McKnight's class. I never really had trouble understanding what was being taught and he was always more than willing to help me when I needed it. He is very interested in chemistry himself, and it shows in his teaching. His exams are straight foward and not terribly hard. He's a good guy and I'd definitely take another class with him.

He posts his powerpoints, which is good if you should happen to miss class. However, his lectures can be difficult to follow, and asking him questions in class does not often result in coherent or useful answers. He can be really touchy. If all the "best" professors are taken this semester, take Dr. McKnight's class- be prepared for Mastering Chem.

>>Professor McKnight: Covers a huge amount of information, but doesn't make it clear how you'll use it, and fails to make it memorable. Lacks clarity and defensive about even constructive criticism. Good guy, but teaching needs work. >>Biochem: Hardest and most complicated Topic @ Geneseo. Intense memorization and understanding required to pass.

This teacher wasn't good at teaching- his power-point slides weren't very useful. You learned a lot on your own. However the final was relatively easy and he gives practice tests and lots of referance sheets. Over all, not too bad.

I did not like this class.  His lectures are disorganized and difficult to understand.  Fortunately I had prior knowledge of the subject so it wasn't too difficult for me.  Otherwise I would have been lost.  Tests are fair, he usually gives a practice test which is very similar to the test.  Reading is not required, and all lectures are online.

He made me want to run to my dependable high school AP Chem teacher. You really need to examine the book outside of class because his lectures are pointless. Suddenly Jamaican slang is more important than chemistry. You need to go to the tutors because he is of no help whatsoever. His tests are relatively easy, but he is a hard grader. >:O

I HATED this class.  He makes people so miserable.  It was an 8:00 class and he stopped lecture because some poor kid yawned in his class.  Do not take a class with him.  He makes you feel like you're a complete moron.
Test is largely based on calculations.  Sometimes goes over things too much and skips over the more difficult topics.
This was a class that I hated to drag myself to. I learned more Jamaican slang than actual chemistry. Unless you like to learn most of the concepts on your own, I wouldn't recommend McKnight.
He is NO help whatsoever outside of class, he moves way too fast, and he wastes so much class time repeating himself or teaching Jamaican slang. I don't recommend him as a teacher.
McKnight never focuses on the more difficult concepts, only the simple ones, but tests you more on the complex.
McKnight is a nice man, but not a very good teacher. He goes too fast in certain areas, and beats simple concepts to death. The tests are pretty straight forward--you just need to study

Really nice fun guy, but a hard teacher. Expects you to memorize lots of material for his tests and is sometimes hard to understand. He has his up and down days. Just know that if he drinks water at 830 in the morning, its gonna be a good day!

I like McKnight a lot on some days and not so much on others. Expects you to know a rediculous amount of information for his tests, but he is willing to give extra credit too.  Nice guy, fun, but not as straight forward as Wendy.
No Comments
Too many good things to say. The best professor ever!! You'll have fun for sure!!!!

You could really tell that she cared about the course and all the students in it. She gave out a workbook that was only $20, had examples of all the material and practice problems for exams. She also posted the completed workbook if you missed class.

There is lots of problem sets to do, all have no clear grading criteria and you will do poorly on the first couple of them and just have to catch up and find out what she wants. There are 16 problem sets total and there isn't really a clear connection between lectures and the homework she has a do. she lowkey wont respect you if youre a woman :(

I struggled in this class but Prof. Aguilar is amazing She is very kind, intelligent, and allows you to complete homework with a partner. Gives mini quizzes that can drag down your grade if you're not careful about studying. Don't be shy about office hours, I wish I had gone to more to study! She also drops the lowest hw and quiz grade.

This class is difficult, but if you put in the work and do the assignments, you will be fine. There is 6 homework's, tests and quizzes, and she will drop your lowest. She is a tough grader, but is always willing to help and you can do retakes if you ask and go to office hours. Very nice professor and would take her for 141 if I could!!

You cannot miss any days of class, or you will fail the next test. She goes way too fast and does a poor job of explaining math concepts. Example questions are easy, and then the test questions are extremely difficult.

Professor Aguilar is a good professor but I struggled in this class. Lectures went incredibly fast and I found myself mindlessly writing down notes to keep up. Going to office hours helps and so do SI sessions. It's crucial to go to class as it is very easy to fall behind. She is very supportive so make sure you reach out if you need help.

Dawn was an amazing professor, she always came prepared to teach, and would always make time to anwser questions. She was very smart and knew what she was teaching, and was always on top of things. I would say the tests were difficult, but if you stud you will do fine.
Was an amazing professor. Very patient and was always willing to help. She created such a safe and enjoyable environment in the classroom. Her teaching was clear and organized.

For being an easier level class, it sometimes makes me want to pull my hair out. She is a very good professor and knows exactly what she is doing. And the fact that she also made a notebook that had all of the problems in it. The tests are just a little bit difficult.

Professor Aguilar I think was one of the best professors I could ask for. She gives a clear understanding on the lessons. Dawn is a tough grader, it is very hard to get a 100 on an assignment as little points are always taken off which can add up quickly. But besides that, she definitely cares about her students and wants to see them succeed.
She is a very clear instructor and really keeps me engaged in class.

I like the way in which she teaches the class but the homework never looks like what we did in class; the problems are always ten times more difficult. She is the toughest grader I've ever met and takes any points possible off, even for the smallest mistakes. Would not recommend nor would I take a class that she teaches ever again.

Listen this class is pretty easy if you show up and pay attention. This seems to be an issue for many people in my section, as we routinely have under 50% attendance. Although I did expect that somewhat, seeing as many in this class are burned out business majors with senioritis. She's a fair grader, teaches well, and doesn't ask too much.

Moves at a very fast pace in class it is very hard to keep up. The tests are not like the notes you take. The test is just a way harder version of the quizzes and worksheets. She does not do a good job explaining whats on the test and makes homework's due the night before tests.
She was very nice and overall I enjoyed her math 140 class, just make sure to show all of your work on assignments and read directions

I have never worked so hard in a class in my entire life. It was very unfair that she graded SO harshly when i would spend HOURS at office hours. My friend was a math major and actually dropped her major after taking this class. I took this class over a year ago as a freshman and she truly caused so much anxiety. I did hours of work every day

She is an awesome professor. She is very nice and is always willing to help. She is a tough grader but you can always go to her office hours for help. Not many assignments, this semester we have 5 homework, 4-5 quizzes, 4 basic skills quizzes, and 3 tests and a final. No make up quizzes or tests if you miss class and no late homework.
adds things to canvas with no heads up, very VERY hard grader, no sympathy for late work or sick days. genuinely i was out sick for ONE day and she did not care gives zeros for everything you miss.
Professor Aguilar is always available for extra help if needed. She is extremely caring and wants the people who care to do well. She is an amazing teacher and is very organized.
She's super nice and always available to help but she's a hard grader.

A few takeaways from Professor Aguilars 140 class. Attendance is mandatory or you will be so lost. No extra credit at all. Homeworks are incredibly difficult so they will make or break your grade. Go to office hours and show you care. Extremely hard grader on exams. You wont pass this class if you dont put the effort in. Amazing Professor tho
